title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
  
  
As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

* Previous experience working in a cross-functional R&D environment with researchers and scientists.
* Technical knowledge of software architectures, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of compliance requirements for regulated software (ISO, FDA, HIPAA, GDPR).

Avantor is looking for Skills Architect is a strong technical/functional advisor who works closely with Skills Builder to define data analytics models, as well as the Decision Data Model in support of the skills workbench to enhance the Decision Intelligent skills catalog.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP functional/technical configurations, BI reporting, and data integration, with the ability to collaborate across architecture, development, and customer-facing teams. This role requires proficiency in
**Prompt Engineering**
for AI-assisted development, along with strong
**API integration knowledge**
and database experience.
  
  
**Major Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Translate business and functional requirements into technical specification documents.
* Architect skills with all features and functions, ensuring all are designed and developed per business requirements.
* Prepare skill blueprints and detailed documentation for each associated skill.
* Responsible for testing and overall QA of the solution from a functional standpoint.
* Collaborate with Decision Architect and Skill Builders to aid development and testing of Decision Data Models and applications.
* Run and support meetings and workshops with prospects and customers, ranging from early discovery sessions to detailed final presentations.
* Ensure operational controls are maintained and perform operating control self-assessments as required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of AERA functional/technical or solutions architecture experience in a team-based environment.
* 2+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Experience with developing Dashboards and Reports using different BI tools.
* Proficient with functional and technical configurations around SAP ECC 6.0 or SCM 5.x or 7.x.
* Strong and hands-on knowledge of key integration points between multiple systems such as SAP ECC, SAP APO, SAP BW, SAP IBP, HANA, Reporting, etc.
* Strong team player, capable of working collaboratively within and across internal and customer teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Prompt Engineering for AI-assisted development workflows and automation.
* Strong API integration and consumption knowledge (RESTful/Web APIs) for solution design and connectivity.
* Ability to convert business needs into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced Agile delivery environment.
* Strong communication skills with business users, QA teams, developers, and customer-facing teams.
* Strong documentation skills for skill blueprints, design specs, test results, and support procedures.
* Good understanding of software development lifecycle, change control procedures, and production support best practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

**Added Advantage / Preferred Skills**

* Working knowledge of function modules, structures, tables, BAPIs, and BADIs.
* Knowledge of data science methods and tools.
* Knowledge and experience working with In-Memory, MPP, column-oriented, and relational database management systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT Codex and Claude Cowork.

title: Senior Vice President, Application Development Manager
description:
**Job Description**
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of
**Senior**
**Vice President,**
**Application Development Manager**
to join our ENTERPRISE RISK ENGINNERING team. This role is located in Pune.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Design and develop applications using Python, PySpark, Flask and other Python related technology stack along with basic working knowledge of Angular and related UI technologies
* Ensure the code quality, security, scalability, and maintainability of the applications.
* Implement CI/CD and DevOps best practices using tools like Maven, Jenkins, Sonar, Jira, Git, etc.
* Work in an agile/POD based environment and deliver features in a timely manner.
* Communicate effectively with other teams and stakeholders to understand the business requirements and provide solutions.
* Drive solutions end to end with ownership
* Good knowledge of Financial Markets & Risk Management domain

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* 12+ years of software development industry experience
* A bachelor's degree or degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Must be good advocate of working from office and encourage team for same
* 5+ years of hands-on experience on Python and related technologies like PySpark, Pandas, NumPy, Flask, Fast API, etc.
* 1+ years of hands-on experience with good working knowledge of Angular, Node, NPM, CSS, HTML, JavaScript etc.
* Good hands-on experience on messaging systems like MQ, Kafka as well as any other integration solutions

* 5+ years of hands-on experience on CI/CD as well as DevOps tools like Maven, Jenkins, Sonar, Jira, Git, Security scanning, Stress Testing, Performance Testing etc.

* Understanding of processes, policies etc. along with domain knowledge preferably Trading & Risk domain business domain knowledge
* Must have 1 year of development experience using AI based tools /editors like Windsurf, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.
* Must have good exposure of using AI/LLM for development, productivity improvements
* Good working experience on Public or Private cloud and related concepts
* Must have good Debugging skills to support any production incidents
* 3+ years of working in Agile/POD with Scrum/Kanban based execution

:

title: Java Full Stack Developer  - Vice President
description:
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as a
**Java Full Stack Developer - Vice President**
, where you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Barclays - Global Technology team. You will also manage stakeholder relationships, communicate complex ideas effectively, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. To design, develop and improve software, utilizing various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
****Accountabilities****

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

To be successful as a
**Java Full Stack Developer - Vice President**
, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Proficiency in Java programming language.
* Expertise in developing and optimizing Java-based applications.
* Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API development.
* Experience designing scalable backend applications in Java.
* Proficiency in both Linux and Windows Server operating systems.
* Familiarity with the complete software development lifecycle and agile methodologies.
* Minimum Qualification – bachelor’s degree.

**Some Highly Valued Skills:**

* Experience with CI/CD tools like GitLab pipelines and TeamCity.
* Proven ability to redesign applications and drive simplification efforts.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
****Accountabilities****

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**Summary:**
We are seeking a skilled GTM Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role plays a critical part in designing, building, and deploying AI agents and AI-enabled workflows, leveraging advanced technologies to drive business outcomes in a B2B SaaS environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in GTM processes, workflow automation, AWS, cloud engineering, and AI technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement end-to-end GTM strategies and processes within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Create and optimize multi-system workflows and automations using REST APIs and event-driven integration patterns.
* Design and deploy serverless applications and event-driven architectures using AWS services.
* Build and integrate AI agents and workflows using Amazon, Claude/Anthropic models, and approved business systems.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into effective technology solutions.
* Ensure AI agents and workflows meet standards for accuracy, reliability, scalability, and security.
* Contribute to the development of standards for AI agent lifecycle management and observability.

**Required Skills**
**GTM & Business Experience**

* 6+ years of experience working directly with GTM processes and systems in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Lead-to-Revenue and customer lifecycle processes.
* Demonstrated understanding of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations workflows.
* Strong understanding of core SaaS commercial concepts and metrics.
* Experience translating business problems into process and technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders and challenge or refine requirements.
* Experience working across multiple GTM platforms and understanding cross-system dependencies.

**Workflow Automation & Integration**

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth, authentication, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience designing multi-system workflows and automations.
* Experience with workflow orchestration technologies.
* Ability to evaluate when low-code/no-code automation is appropriate versus custom development.
* Experience with platforms such as Zapier, n8n, Workato, Make, Tray.io, or comparable technologies is beneficial but not required.
* Experience with web scraping, browser automation, data extraction, or related technologies is beneficial.
* Ability to quickly learn and evaluate emerging automation and data acquisition technologies.

**AWS & Cloud Engineering**

* Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda and serverless application patterns.
* Experience with AWS Step Functions or comparable workflow orchestration concepts.
* Experience with Amazon EventBridge and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with Amazon Bedrock or demonstrated experience building applications using foundation-model APIs.
* Familiarity with API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, Secrets Manager, S3, queues, databases, and related AWS services.
* Understanding of cloud security, permissions, monitoring, and production support practices.

**AI Agents & Agentic Orchestration**

* Design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI-enabled workflows within the approved architecture.
* Use Amazon and Claude / Anthropic models for reasoning, classification, summarization, research, recommendations, and decision support.
* Build agentic workflows combining LLM reasoning with structured business data, APIs, deterministic rules, web-derived information, and approved tools.
* Integrate agents with approved business systems and data sources through available APIs, connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities.
* Understand how to discover, configure, and use available MCP servers and tools within AI workflows.
* Evaluate when an existing MCP capability can simplify access to a system or data source rather than building a custom integration.
* Design prompts, context, structured outputs, tool/function calling, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Determine when deterministic workflow logic should be used instead of an LLM or agent.
* Test agents and workflows for accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, cost, and measurable business value.
* Contribute to standards for agent permissions, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

**AI & LLM Technologies**
Candidates should have hands-on experience with or strong practical knowledge of:
  
  

* Claude / Anthropic and/or other leading foundation models
* Prompt and context engineering
* Structured outputs
* Tool / function calling
* Agentic workflows and AI orchestration
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts and use of MCP-enabled tools
* Connecting AI workflows to approved systems and data sources
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts
* Human-in-the-loop patterns
* Model and agent evaluation
* AI observability
* AI security, guardrails, data privacy, and responsible AI

Prior MCP experience is beneficial but not required. Candidates should be able to quickly learn and leverage MCP-enabled capabilities as part of AI and automation workflows.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.
  
  
**Our Culture**
**Who We Are**
Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.
  
  
**How We Work**

* We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
* Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
* Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
* We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.
  
  
Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
* Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
* Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
* Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
* Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
* Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments
* Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
* Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
* Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
* Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
* Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
* Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
* Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs
* Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions
* Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

*Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe different perspectives make us stronger. Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Blitzy’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process*

* Product Bundles
* Price Rules
* Price Lists
* Deal Guidance Rules
* Approval Processes
* User Roles and Security

**Stakeholder Engagement & Continuous Improvement**

**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**

– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.

What we offer

We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. title: AVP- Fullstack AI Engineer- HR Tech
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
As Jefferies transitions from traditional SaaS workflows to an Agentic AI Operating Model, the skillsets required to manage the platform shift fundamentally. The platform relies on continuous monitoring, external signal processing (Watcher Agents), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) governance.
  
  
We are seeking a hybrid engineering profile—a Lead AI Engineer—who bridges the gap between enterprise systems integration, LLM prompt governance, and complex business logic. This role goes beyond traditional "keep the lights on" IT support; this individual will act as the operational pilot of the AI platform, tuning agent behavior, ensuring data security, and evolving the system's capabilities to meet dynamic business demands.
  
  
You will be the primary technical owner of the platform: operating and hardening it in production, extending its AI agent workflows and enterprise integrations, and driving the Phase 2 roadmap (candidate portal, scheduling, assessments, and further automation).
  
  
**Technology Stack**

* Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
* Backend: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, async I/O, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
* AI / Agents: LangGraph and LangChain agent pipelines with AWS-hosted LLMs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock), human-in-the-loop approval gates, agent control room, prompt and eval management
* Database: MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB (document modeling, async access via Motor)
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, structured logging, metrics, tracing, audit trails
* Enterprise integrations: Oracle ORC (HRIS — requisitions, candidates, scorecards), PeopleSoft incl. CSS (staffing & comp), background-check vendor APIs (e.g., First Advantage — bidirectional), DocuSign e-signature, Microsoft Exchange / Outlook via Graph API, ServiceNow ITSM
* Sourcing channel integrations: LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (One-Click Export ingest), Indeed Retrieve Candidates API (GraphQL + OAuth), Naukri ATS webhook ingest

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own production operations of the platform: monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and SLA adherence (“keep the lights on”).
* Evolve the platform on the delivered foundation: design, build, and ship new features across the React frontend and FastAPI backend.
* Maintain and extend agentic AI workflows — agent nodes, prompts, guardrails, tool bindings, and human-in-the-loop approval gates — including evaluation and bias-governance of AI scoring.
* Operate and extend the connector framework integrating Oracle ORC, PeopleSoft, BGC vendors, DocuSign, Exchange/O365, and ServiceNow.
* Maintain sourcing-channel ingestion pipelines — LinkedIn RSC candidate export, Indeed Retrieve Candidates API streaming, and Naukri webhook receivers — feeding the Sourcing Agent's scoring and shortlisting.
* Manage data models and pipelines in MongoDB/DocumentDB, ensuring data quality, sync integrity across systems of record, and auditability.
* Own the AWS infrastructure via IaC and CI/CD; manage environments, releases, security posture (SSO/RBAC), and cost.
* Maintain observability: dashboards, agent audit trails, structured logs, alerts, and operational runbooks.
* Partner with HR Ops, Recruiting, Legal/Compliance, and IT stakeholders to prioritize the backlog and translate business needs into platform capabilities.
* Agent Operations: Monitor, tune, and deploy updates to specialized AI process agents (e.g., automated sourcing, offer generation, candidate triage) utilizing Jefferies' internal LLM gateways.
* Ontology & Knowledge Base Maintenance: Continuously update the system’s Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge graph (e.g., uploading new compliance policies, visa regulations, or compensation matrices) to ensure agents reason against the latest ground-truth data.
* Data Sovereignty & PII Handling: Proven ability to architect data-masking pipelines to ensure highly sensitive data (Compensation, SSNs, Diversity metrics) is encrypted, scrubbed, and strictly isolated from broader LLM reasoning engines.
* Algorithmic Bias & Regulatory Auditing: Familiarity with validating AI outputs against strict employment and compliance laws (e.g., EEOC guidelines, NY Fair Chance Act constraints) to ensure automated workflows remain legally defensible and auditable.
* Lead knowledge transfer from the delivery partner and serve as the internal technical authority for the platform.

**Required Skills & Experience Skill AreaWhat We Expect**
Full-stack engineering Strong professional software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems
  
  
Python backend (FastAPI) Async Python services, REST APIs, Pydantic data modeling, SSE/streaming patterns
  
  
React / TypeScript Modern React (hooks, router), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS; component-driven UI
  
  
MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB Document data modeling, aggregation pipelines, async drivers (Motor), performance tuning
  
  
AWS cloud & DevOps ECS/EKS or similar container runtimes, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, Docker
  
  
GenAI / agentic systems LLM application development — LangChain/LangGraph or similar, prompt design, human-in-the-loop workflows, evals
  
  
Enterprise integrations Building/maintaining API integrations with enterprise systems (HRIS, ITSM, e-signature, email/Graph API); webhook ingest, OAuth, and partner-API patterns (e.g., LinkedIn RSC, Indeed, Naukri)
  
  
Observability & operations Structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, incident response, runbooks
  
  
**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java Full stack with AI
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Engineer - Java Full stack with AI
  
  
**All About Us**
MasterCard is a technology company in the global payments business. We connect consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses worldwide and enable them to use secure and convenient electronic forms of payment.
  
  
Join the industry’s most passionate, motivated & engaged global team - Our employees are encouraged to drive innovation every day in support of a more connected world – A World Beyond Cash.
  
  
**Overview**
The MasterCard B&MI Technology development team is engaged in working with new and innovative technologies to build business solutions that keep MasterCard positioned as a leader in delivering value added business analytic and reporting solutions to our diverse customer base. We work collaboratively with our product partners and other technical teams to continuously improve and enhance our existing products and drive new products to the global marketplace. We are currently seeking candidates that will be responsible to support the technical lead in overall architecture, design and produce a high-quality code using different languages.
  
  
**Role**

* This position is a member of the MasterCard B&MI Technology focusing on development of Enterprise Application Development using Java tech stack and Angular/React as the Front-end technologies.
* Participate in the gathering of business requirements.
* Ensure software designs align with MasterCard’s Enterprise Architecture and leverage our enterprise services.
* Ensure product development meets MasterCard’s business needs.
* Ensure development teams use the appropriate MasterCard standard development methodologies and follow our technology standards, and that all projects and development are appropriately documented.
* Ensure that software and system design and delivery support the goal of zero down time in production.
* Work closely with business partners on product definition, product roadmaps, business case development, and overall direction for the team.
* Respond to operational and business concerns or issues relative to future business programs, projects, or enhancements to ensure consistent delivery of quality services.
* Ensure development supports all appropriate certifications and compliance requirements, including those for PCI, GLBA, Safe Harbor, and others.
* Responsible for performance engineering of the enterprise software architecture, and providing functional guidance, advice, and/or training to other application developers.
* Responsible for designing, developing, testing, delivering, and monitoring scalable and secure cloud architectures, using various AWS cloud and cloud native platforms, such as EC2, ECS, S3.
* Need to improve and expand the existing platform by ensuring that it is resilient, secure, and scalable.

**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience with 7+ years of industry experience.
* Strong experience in Full Stack Java development using J2EE, Java 8 or higher, JSP, Servlets, Spring 5, Hibernate, and backend service development.
* Proven expertise in building and consuming Web Services (SOAP/RESTful APIs) and developing scalable, high-performance applications.
* Solid understanding of relational (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Postgres) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, etc.), with ability to write efficient and optimized queries.
* Experience working with frontend technologies such as React or Angular, along with HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, and CSS.
* Hands-on experience with application servers such as WebSphere, JBoss, and Tomcat, and development environments including Visual Studio, RAD, Eclipse, IntelliJ, and VS Code.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools such as Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Chef, SonarQube, with understanding of automated build and deployment processes.
* Experience in cloud-native application development using platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, including deployment, monitoring, and scaling of applications.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, and microservices-based architecture.
* Exposure to big data and data engineering ecosystems, including Databricks, Apache Spark, ETL pipelines, and Delta Lake concepts.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and AI-powered development tools (e.g., Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or code generation), and ability to integrate AI/ML services/APIs into applications.
* Experience with UNIX environments (Shell scripting, awk), along with XML/XSLT and related technologies.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC methodologies, with experience in both Agile and Waterfall models.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across multiple organizational levels and global teams.
* High-energy, detail-oriented, proactive mindset with ability to work independently under pressure, demonstrating strong ownership and self-motivation.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a proven track record of collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:

This role combines hands-on development, solution design, application support, integration delivery, and people leadership. The successful candidate will lead and mentor a team of three developers while remaining actively involved in the design, development, review, deployment, and support of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), APIs, and related SCM solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong experience across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C), along with advanced Oracle PL/SQL, Oracle APIs, OIC integrations, REST/SOAP services, reporting, DevOps, and production support capabilities.

* Act as the technical lead for SCM application enhancements, integrations, incident resolution, and production support.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle EBS SCM modules, with working knowledge of P2P and O2C business processes.
* Advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills, including packages, procedures, functions, triggers, performance tuning, and debugging.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including adapters, connections, mappings, orchestrations, schedules, fault handling, monitoring, and integration troubleshooting.
* Strong API-development experience using REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, error handling, versioning, and API documentation.
* Experience with Oracle APIs, interface tables, concurrent programs, SQL\*Loader, and data migration/conversion techniques.
* Experience with Oracle Reports Builder, XML Publisher/BI Publisher, and Discoverer or equivalent reporting technologies.
* Experience with DevOps practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release-management processes.
* Ability to develop high-quality technical designs and conduct structured code and design reviews.
* Experience creating and maintaining process flows, system integration diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and technical architecture visuals using Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or comparable diagramming tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, production-support, and root-cause-analysis skills.

Leadership & Professional Skills
  
  

* Prior experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a small technical team.
* Ability to balance team leadership responsibilities with hands-on technical delivery.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to manage priorities, deadlines, risks, and dependencies.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively within Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid delivery models.
* Commitment to documentation, knowledge transfer, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

**Technologies**

Oracle E-Business Suite, SCM, P2P, O2C

The

is a senior-level technical leadership role responsible for establishing, designing, and delivering high-quality, scalable application systems and software solutions in coordination with cross-functional technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to drive end-to-end applications systems analysis, architectural alignment, full-stack software engineering, and implementation activities across distributed enterprise environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Solution Delivery
  
  

* System Integration & Product Delivery: Partner with engineering managers, product owners, and multi-disciplinary teams to establish architectural roadmaps, integrate enterprise services, and deliver core system enhancements and new digital capabilities.
* Architecture & Engineering Standards: Ensure software and application designs strictly adhere to enterprise architecture blueprints, security baselines, and industry best practices.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Resolve high-impact, critical engineering and architectural challenges through in-depth evaluation of complex business flows, technical bottlenecks, system dependencies, and industry standards.
* Coding & Quality Governance: Define, champion, and enforce engineering standards for clean code, design patterns, automated unit/integration testing, debugging, code reviews, and release readiness.
* Cross-Functional Domain Alignment: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of how application architecture, infrastructure, data management, and business capabilities integrate to achieve business objectives.

Innovation, AI-Augmented Engineering & Coaching
  
  

* Innovative Problem-Solving: Apply interpretive thinking and structured analysis to identify complex technical problems, proposing modern, scalable, and resilient technical solutions.
* AI-First Software Delivery: Actively leverage generative AI and modern developer-productivity tools to accelerate software delivery cycles, streamline automated test creation, refactor legacy code, and elevate code quality.
* Mentorship & Team Guidance: Serve as a technical advisor and mentor to mid-level software engineers and analysts, leading technical discussions and delegating engineering tasks effectively.

Risk, Compliance & Governance
  
  

* Risk & Controls Assessment: Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding client assets.
* Regulatory & Policy Compliance: Drive compliance with applicable laws, rules, and enterprise standards; apply sound ethical judgment; and escalate, manage, and report control issues with full transparency.

* Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Hibernate / JPA.
* Microservices Architecture: Proven track record of architecting, implementing, and deploying high-throughput, low-latency, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed processing systems.
* Messaging & Event-Driven Systems: Hands-on experience with asynchronous messaging and event streaming technologies (Apache Kafka, Solace, or JMS).
* API Standards: Expertise designing and developing enterprise-grade RESTful APIs and gRPC services with strong authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).
* Modern Frontend Engineering (React / Angular)
* Frontend Frameworks: Deep practical experience building modern, responsive web applications using React and/or Angular with TypeScript and modern ECMAScript (ES6+).
* State Management & Reactive Programming: Proficiency in state management patterns (Redux / NgRx) and reactive streams using RxJS.
* Modern UI & Micro-Frontends: Hands-on experience with Micro-Frontend architectures, standalone components, dynamic routing, and complex enterprise data grids (e.g., AG Grid Enterprise, Elemental UI / Design System components).
* Web Fundamentals & Real-Time Data: Strong mastery of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, DOM manipulation, responsive layouts, and bidirectional communication protocols (WebSockets / Server-Sent Events).
* Database & Data Engineering
* Relational Databases (RDBMS): Deep experience with relational data modeling, schema design, advanced SQL tuning, and query optimization on enterprise databases (Oracle,).
* NoSQL Data Stores: Practical experience designing, indexing, and maintaining document/key-value NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Couchbase).
* High Availability & Scalability: Solid understanding of database clustering, indexing strategies, replica sets, connection pooling, and caching strategies .
* CI/CD, Containerization & Cloud Operations
* Containers & Orchestration: Proven experience containerizing applications using Docker and deploying onto container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift).
* Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines: Hands-on proficiency configuring automated build, test, and release pipelines using modern enterprise platforms (Harness, Jenkins, Tekton, or GitHub Actions) in Linux environments.
* Job Scheduling & Batch Systems: Familiarity with enterprise workload automation and job schedulers (Autosys or equivalent).
* Quality & Security Tooling: Experience integrating automated code quality, dependency management, and vulnerability scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx).
* AI-Assisted Engineering
* AI-First Tooling: Demonstrated proficiency integrating Generative AI developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or internal LLM coding assistants) into daily development workflows to enhance productivity, code generation, and test coverage.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience: 6–10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering and application architecture, with demonstrated experience leading technical delivery within enterprise environments.

title: Full Stack Engineering Lead-Vice President
description:
The
**Full Stack Engineering Lead (C13)**
is a senior technical leadership role responsible for the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of critical, high-performance enterprise applications. This role requires an experienced engineering leader who can bridge the gap between modern, responsive front-end user interfaces and robust, scalable back-end distributed microservices.
  
  
As a C13 Technical Lead, you will drive technical excellence across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), mentor engineering teams, establish coding and architectural standards, and implement automated CI/CD deployment pipelines within a fast-paced, Agile delivery environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture
* Architectural Strategy: Design resilient, scalable, and secure full-stack enterprise solutions aligning with modern microservices architectures and cloud-native patterns.
* Technical Governance: Drive code quality, code reviews, design patterns, and engineering best practices across front-end and back-end workstreams.
* Framework Modernization: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools to modernize existing legacy systems and accelerate digital transformation.
* Full Stack Application Engineering
* Front-End Development: Lead UI/UX implementation using modern web technologies (Angular 14+ / React 18+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, State Management like NgRx/Redux, Webpack/Vite).
* Back-End & Microservices: Develop high-throughput, low-latency RESTful APIs and distributed services using Core Java (Java 17/21), Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, Spring Data JPA).
* Database Architecture: Design relational database schemas, write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and packages (Oracle DB, PL/SQL), and perform database performance tuning, indexing, and query optimization.
* CI/CD & DevOps Automation
* Pipeline Delivery: Design and implement robust automated Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Package and deploy applications using Docker and deploy to container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift.
* Quality & Security Automation: Integrate static code analysis (SonarQube), open-source scanning, dynamic security testing, and automated artifact publishing (Artifactory / Nexus) directly into CI/CD gates.
* Agile Delivery & Team Mentorship
* Agile Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, and QA engineers to define technical user stories, estimate delivery velocity, and manage sprint backlogs.
* Team Development: Provide hands-on mentorship, technical guidance, and career coaching to mid-level and junior engineers.
* Production Support & Operational Resilience: Drive incident resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), observability (using tools like Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki), and maintain high system uptime and disaster recovery readiness.

Technical Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Front-End**

* Strong expertise in Angular (v12+) or React.js (v16+)
* Advanced TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, SCSS/CSS3
* State management libraries (NgRx, RxJS, Redux, Zustand)
* UI Component Libraries & Responsive Design (Material UI, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS)

**Back-End**

* Deep hands-on experience with Java (Java 11/17/21) and Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security)
* RESTful API architecture and design (OpenAPI/Swagger specs)
* Event-driven messaging / asynchronous processing (Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, or RabbitMQ)

**Database**

* Proficient in Oracle Database 19c+ & PL/SQL (Stored Procedures, Triggers, Views, Functions)
* ORM frameworks (Hibernate, Spring Data JPA, MyBatis)
* SQL execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and performance tuning

**DevOps & CI/CD**

* Hands-on CI/CD pipeline authoring (Jenkins, Tekton, Harness, GitHub Actions)
* Build & dependency tools (Maven, Gradle, npm, yarn)
* Containerization & orchestration (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift)
* Version control: Git / GitHub / Bitbucket (branching strategies, PR workflows)

**Testing & Quality**

* Automated unit and integration testing (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
* Front-end testing frameworks (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, Playwright)
* Code quality gates (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk)

Experience & Leadership Profile
  
  

* Total Experience: 10+ years of software development experience with at least 3+ years in a Technical Lead or Senior Full Stack Engineer capacity.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Financial Services / Enterprise Experience: Prior experience in banking, financial services, wealth management, or highly regulated enterprise environments is strongly preferred.
* Problem Solving & Communication: Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

**About Agoda**

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Engineer III - Cloud
description:

Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
  
  
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
  
  
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to core platform services powering connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving underlying platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines).
* Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio.
* Develop both connectors and platform services working with complex authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys).
* Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership across our fleet of Falcon environments.
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

****What You'll Need:****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software systems across all phases of the development lifecycle, preferably in a SaaS model.
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go.
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Hands-on experience in large-scale system architecture, high scalability, availability, and optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills with a track record of working collaboratively across stakeholders.

****Bonus Points:****

* Experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Contributions to open-source communities.
* Hands-on Golang experience.
* Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.
