title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to spearhead the modernisation of a large-scale enterprise application from legacy ASP.NET to a modern .NET 10 Web API and React stack. You will own the technical direction of a cross-functional delivery pod, mentor a team of developers, and drive hands-on engineering across both frontend and backend.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role — you will write production code, lead architecture decisions, and be accountable for the technical quality of everything your pod delivers. You will work in a structured Agile environment, collaborating closely with the Solution Architect, QA leads, and client stakeholders across a multi-year, multi-phase modernisation programme.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end technical delivery of your pod — architecture, design, coding, code review, and quality gates
* Lead the migration from legacy ASP.NET (MVC / Web API / Web Forms) to .NET 10 REST APIs and React 18 frontend
* Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, and PR review process across the pod
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for all significant technical choices
* Conduct structured code reviews covering architecture, security, performance, and maintainability — not just syntax
* Identify and resolve technical debt proactively; maintain a tech debt register visible to stakeholders
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) with quality gates: SonarQube, unit coverage, OWASP dependency scan
* Collaborate with Solution Architect on cross-pod API contracts, shared services, and infrastructure decisions

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Design and build .NET 10 Web API microservices using Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design patterns
* Build React 18 SPAs: component architecture, Redux Toolkit / Zustand state management, routing, and performance optimisation
* Implement OAuth2 / OIDC / JWT authentication and role-based access control
* Design and optimise relational database schemas (SQL Server / PostgreSQL); write complex LINQ and EF Core queries
* Build and consume RESTful APIs with versioning, error handling, and OpenAPI documentation
* Write unit, integration, and contract tests as a core part of the Definition of Done

**Migration & Modernisation**

* Lead the technical approach for migrating legacy ASP.NET code to .NET 10 — analysis, characterisation testing, phased migration, parity validation
* Use GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate migration while maintaining review discipline
* Identify breaking changes, deprecated dependencies, and third-party package migration paths
* Establish repeatable migration patterns that the whole pod can follow consistently across modules
* Ensure all migrated code has adequate unit test coverage before merge — parity tests are non-negotiable

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead a pod of 4–6 engineers (mix of senior, mid, and junior developers)
* Run daily technical standups, remove technical blockers, and escalate risks to the Architect early
* Mentor mid and junior developers through pair programming, code reviews, and 1:1 technical guidance
* Create a learning environment — internal tech talks, documentation, actionable review feedback
* Make resourcing recommendations and flag capacity risks to the Delivery Manager

**Agile Delivery (Added Advantage)**

* Participate in Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Standup, Sprint Review, Retrospective, Backlog Grooming
* Collaborate with the Product Owner / BA to refine user stories, provide technical input on acceptance criteria, and raise technical stories
* Provide accurate SP estimates; track sprint progress and flag scope risk early
* Support the Scrum Master in removing impediments with a technical root cause
* Champion the Definition of Done — ensure every story that ships meets quality, test, and documentation standards

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

title: Platform Engineering Lead- Data Services & Reporting
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on
**SVP – Platform Engineering Lead**
to be based in Pune. In this critical engineering leadership role, you will provide engineering leadership, technical governance, and
**architectural alignment**
across our enterprise-wide
**Data and Reporting landscape**
.
  
  
This is a senior, highly technical engineering leadership and platform delivery role designed for a seasoned platform architect or software engineer. It is
**not**
a program management or PMO role. This position serves as a critical bridge that
**cuts across the entire data and reporting lifecycle**
—from raw data sources and federated query engines to the presentation, business intelligence, and AI-enabled experience layers.
  
  
You will hold
**complete design authority and technical governance**
over a platform that has a global footprint and affects business users and applications worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and driving our unified platform engineering strategy, standards, and best practices. Working in close partnership with our Enterprise Architecture teams and the wider department's AI design groups, you will lead the effort to rationalize our current platform landscape, ensuring that our data virtualization capabilities, APIs, and reporting engines are integrated into a cohesive, highly scalable, resilient, and sustainable end-to-end global ecosystem.
  
  
A core expectation of this role is the active adoption and promotion of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other developer productivity tools) to significantly accelerate software delivery, automate infrastructure-as-code, and elevate technical design quality across the entire data and reporting stack.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cross-Cutting Platform Engineering Strategy & Alignment
* End-to-End Strategic Roadmap: Define and execute the long-term platform engineering strategy and technical roadmap that seamlessly integrates the enterprise Data Services and Reporting platforms, ensuring strict alignment with enterprise standards.
* Landscape Rationalization: Review, analyze, and hands-on rationalize the entire platform landscape—consolidating both backend data processing layers and frontend business intelligence/reporting inventories to eliminate redundant capabilities, reduce technical debt, and drive operational efficiency.
* Enterprise Architecture Partnership: Serve as the primary technical liaison with the broader Technology organization and Enterprise Architecture / Common Architecture Groups, partnering closely to translate enterprise-level blueprints into scalable, high-performance platform implementations.
* Unified Semantic & Metric Layer: Establish and enforce standards for a centralized, unified semantic layer that bridges federated query engines directly with BI platforms, ensuring consistent business metrics and a "single source of truth" from database to dashboard.
* AI-Accelerated Platform Delivery: Champion and drive the adoption of generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) across platform engineering teams to accelerate software development, automate schema and infrastructure-as-code generation, and streamline system refactoring.
* Platform AI Capabilities & Wider AI Alignment
* AI Capability Definition & Design: Actively work to define, architect, and design the core platform's AI and conversational query capabilities (including natural language interfaces and autonomous agent infrastructures).
* Departmental AI Coordination: Partner in close coordination with the wider department's AI architecture and design groups to ensure all conversational and agentic AI deliverables are seamlessly integrated, interoperable, and fully aligned with global AI patterns and security guardrails.
* Production Estate Management & Technical Debt Elimination
* Production Monitoring Standards: Enforce rigorous estate management standards by ensuring each application team designs and implements comprehensive, real-time production monitoring, observability, and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or equivalent).
* Tech Debt Prevention: Proactively drive platform patterns that simplify operations, ensure ease of production estate management, and systematically eliminate and prevent the incurrence of technical debt across the application lifecycle.
* Data Virtualization & Federation Industrialization
* Query Federation Industrialization: Lead the enterprise-scale industrialization of our query federation and data virtualization capabilities, establishing logical data access patterns that allow real-time query execution across dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement.
* Standardized APIs & Data Access Patterns: Design and implement standardized, highly secure APIs and reusable data access patterns (leveraging Java/Spring Boot frameworks) to support high-performance, real-time data consumption by downstream reporting and analytical engines.
* Centralized Security & Entitlements: Enforce robust governance controls, row/column-level data masking, and fine-grained access controls (e.g., Apache Ranger) across the virtualization layer to ensure secure data delivery to all reporting consumers.
* Reporting Platform & Experience Layer Integration
* Reporting Platform Architecture: Modernize the reporting and business intelligence infrastructure, ensuring that high-concurrency BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, and automated document generation engines like Aspose) are optimized to query virtualized data structures in real time.
* High-Throughput Performance Tuning: Optimize query performance and end-to-end latency across the entire stack—from the query federation engine down to the frontend visualization layer—enabling instant, interactive dashboards and conversational data search.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship
* Technical Mentorship: Provide strong technical leadership, architectural guidance, and mentorship to a global team of platform engineers, data architects, and reporting developers.
* Culture of Innovation: Foster a high-performance engineering culture focused on automation, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), and modern platform engineering practices.

Technology Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Required Technical Skillsets (Must Be Hands-on)**

* Java Software Engineering (Core Competence): Advanced, hands-on expertise in Java and enterprise Java frameworks (specifically Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Hibernate/JPA). Proven track record of architecting, reviewing, and governing high-performance backend microservices, robust platform integration layers, and custom API layers.
* Data Federation & Query Optimization (Required Concepts): Deep understanding of distributed query execution, query plans, pushdown optimization, and logical data fabric/data virtualization concepts.
* BI & Reporting Platform Engineering: Strong architectural knowledge of enterprise BI and reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom JavaScript/React web dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting and document generation engines).
* AI-Assisted Development (Must-Have): Proven capability and hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to accelerate software delivery, write platform code, generate tests, and optimize development workflows.
* Enterprise Architecture & Implementation Design: Proven track record of designing and implementing high-scale, distributed, and resilient enterprise architectures bridging data storage, virtualization, APIs, and reporting in alignment with enterprise standards.
* API Design & Governance: Strong expertise in designing standardized REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and secure data access patterns.
* Database Engineering & Security: Deep knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server), distributed storage systems, and centralized data access governance frameworks (e.g., Apache Ranger).

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets**

* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering (Highly Preferred): Conceptual or hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks and libraries (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, or equivalent) to design, architect, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering pipelines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Data Virtualization Platforms (Highly Preferred): Deep hands-on or design experience with query federation engines such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* AI Platform Engineering & LLM Architecture: Conceptual or hands-on understanding of engineering platform infrastructure to support AI workloads, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), managing prompt engineering pipelines, vector databases, and deploying model hosting platforms.
* Modern Lakehouse Platforms: Experience working with cloud-native enterprise data lakehouse or warehouse platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
* Distributed Compute Engines: Familiarity with Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience with modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift), enterprise workload automation (Autosys), and automated infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
* Production Observability Tools: Experience implementing and utilizing monitoring and observability toolsets (specifically Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or similar) for enterprise-scale estate management.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Total Engineering Experience: Minimum 12-15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture within a large-scale, highly regulated environment (preferably financial services).
* Technical Leadership: Minimum 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership, principal architect, or platform tech lead role, with a proven track record of driving large-scale platform modernization, rationalization, and technical governance across both data and reporting systems.
* Agile Engineering: Experience driving technical delivery and architectural alignment within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, collaborating closely with engineering teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.

description:

Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead end-to-end project delivery, drive engineering excellence, and build high-performing teams.
  
  
This role is designed for an engineering leader who has grown through hands-on software development, progressed into a Tech Lead role, and now manages small to mid-sized engineering teams.
  
  
The Engineering Manager will own project execution, delivery outcomes, customer relationships, and technical direction.
  
  
You will work closely with customers, architects, and engineering teams to solve complex technology challenges.
  
  
The role combines delivery ownership, team leadership, account growth, and active involvement in modern engineering practices.
  
  
At Indexnine, we are building an AI-first engineering culture where teams use AI to improve how software is designed, developed, tested, and delivered.
  
  
This role provides opportunities to experiment with emerging technologies, work on complex digital engineering programs, and grow as a technology leader.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical direction on architecture, design decisions, engineering practices, and solution approaches.

* Review technical implementations, resolve critical engineering challenges, and ensure high-quality delivery standards.

* Own complete project delivery across timelines, budget, quality, risks, and team coordination.

* Build strong customer relationships through transparency, ownership, and consistent delivery.

**Engineering & DevOps Excellence**

* Implement Agile delivery practices using Scrum, Kanban, and modern project management approaches.
* Promote DevOps practices that improve reliability, automation, and delivery efficiency.
* Encourage adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows and modern development practices.

**Team Management**

* Manage day-to-day engineering activities, priorities, and team deliverables.
* Mentor engineers and support their technical and professional growth.
* Create a culture focused on ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

* 9+ years of experience in software engineering and project delivery.

* Strong understanding of software architecture, full-stack development, and modern engineering frameworks.
* Experience with technologies such as Node.js, React, Angular, Java, or similar technology stacks.

* Hands-on exposure to AI-powered software development practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong curiosity and ability to continuously learn emerging technologies, especially in AI.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead teams through empathy, active listening, and clear direction.

* Ability to manage customer conversations, priorities, and conflicts effectively.

title: Software Engineer (Angular, Front-End Focused Full Stack)
description:
**Job Description: cc**
**Location:**
Vadodara / Pune
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Working Hours:**
12:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  
  
**Experience:**
5+ Years
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with strong front-end development expertise in Angular and working knowledge of full-stack development using .NET technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing responsive, accessible, high-performance web applications using Angular, HTML, CSS, and modern front-end technologies. The role also involves contributing to backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core, building and integrating RESTful APIs, and collaborating with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders.
  
  
The candidate should have a strong understanding of modern front-end architecture, UI/UX implementation, application performance, accessibility, security, and maintainable software development practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand business requirements and translate UI/UX designs from Figma or Adobe XD into high-quality, pixel-perfect code.
* Estimate development efforts and contribute to technical planning.
* Design and develop scalable, maintainable Angular applications using reusable components, modules, lazy loading, and state management.
* Build responsive, cross-browser-compatible user interfaces using semantic HTML5 and modern CSS/SCSS.
* Develop and maintain reusable UI component libraries and contribute to design systems.
* Ensure compliance with web accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1.
* Optimize front-end performance, including Core Web Vitals, bundle size, change detection, and rendering.
* Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and develop or maintain backend APIs using ASP.NET Core as required.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and other team members to deliver seamless user experiences.
* Research and evaluate suitable tools, libraries, and frameworks.
* Guide and support junior developers, particularly on front-end development practices.
* Follow Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and perform unit testing.
* Participate in code reviews, refactoring, debugging, and validation against requirements and test cases.
* Follow application security practices, including protection against XSS and CSRF and secure token handling.
* Recommend product and user experience improvements.
* Communicate effectively with team members, clients, product owners, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain technical documentation, participate in Scrum ceremonies, and track tasks using project management tools.
* Participate in relevant training and team activities.

**Required Skills – Must Have**
**Front-End Development**

* Angular: Strong hands-on experience with Angular 14 or higher; Angular 16+ preferred.
* Strong understanding of Angular components, directives, pipes, services, and dependency injection.
* Experience with routing, lazy loading, route guards, and HTTP interceptors.
* Experience with reactive forms and custom validations.
* Good understanding of RxJS and reactive programming patterns.
* Knowledge of standalone components and Angular Signals.
* Experience with state management tools such as NgRx, NGXS, or signal-based stores.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript (ES6+).
* Strong knowledge of semantic HTML5 and SEO-friendly markup.
* Proficiency in CSS3 and SCSS/SASS, including Flexbox, CSS Grid, responsive design, media queries, transitions, and animations.
* Experience ensuring cross-browser compatibility and following CSS architecture practices such as BEM.

**UI Development, Accessibility & Testing**

* Experience with Angular Material, PrimeNG, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, or similar UI component libraries and CSS frameworks.
* Understanding of web accessibility standards, including WCAG.
* Experience with front-end performance optimization.
* Experience with unit testing using Jasmine/Karma or Jest.

**Backend Development**

* Working experience with C# and ASP.NET Core 6 or higher.
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs.
* Understanding of relational database fundamentals, including normalization, indexing, and query performance.
* Experience with Entity Framework or Dapper.
* Ability to write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, and related operations.

**Tools & Development Practices**

* Experience with Git and version control.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Redmine, Azure DevOps, or Asana.
* Understanding of CI/CD processes and tools.
* Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* End-to-end testing using Cypress or Playwright.
* Experience with Angular Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Progressive Web Applications (PWA), or micro-frontends using Module Federation.
* Experience with Storybook for component development and documentation.
* Familiarity with Figma, Adobe XD, and UI/UX design handoff.
* Exposure to other front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.
* Backend unit testing using NUnit, xUnit, or MSTest.
* Understanding of NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Understanding of DevOps tools and technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, Linux fundamentals, and scripting.
* Understanding of microservices architecture.

**Experience & Candidate Profile**

* Minimum 5+ years of full-stack software development experience.
* Strong preference for candidates with substantial hands-on Angular front-end development experience.
* Ability to build maintainable, accessible, responsive, and high-performance applications.
* Comfortable contributing to both front-end and .NET backend development.
* Able to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume highlighting relevant Angular, front-end development, and C#/.NET experience.
  
  
Skills: react,pwa,mstest,kubernetes,database design,vue,c#,angularjs,.net core,angular,linux,xunit,nunit,asp.net core,indexing,asp.net,typescript,cypress,asp.net web api,nosql,front-end development,microservices architecture

title: Sr. Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.
  
  
As a Sr. Software Engineer at OpenGov, you will develop top-tier SaaS solutions that enhance efficiency, transparency, and accountability in government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential for maintaining the highest standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.
* Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.
* Provide leadership and technical guidance to ensure the development of resilient, scalable SaaS applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Troubleshoot, debug and resolve complex technical issues.
* Mentor and guide junior software engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality
* Cultivate customer empathy to ensure that the solutions exceed customer expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and operational excellence.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in developing highly scalable cloud-native applications.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, and NodeJS is a MUST.
* Prior experience in .Net stack
* Proficiency with event-driven architecture, API integration, and GraphQL is a MUST
* Deep experience building applications on either Azure or AWS using the latest CI/CD and DevOps best practices
* Prior experience in building applications that leverage modern tools like Grafana for observability and performance monitoring
* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment.
* Demonstrated experience in working with customers to improve product experiences
* Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end
* Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)
* BA/BS in a computer science-related field or equivalent experience required.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.

As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Trusted by organizations like Girl Scouts, Habitat for Humanity, and ASAE, our unified platform replaces the patchwork of disconnected tools that hold mission-driven organizations back.

description:

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. **What You'll Bring**

* Full Stack Ownership — Confidence and capability to own features end-to-end across UI, API, and database layers without siloed thinking.
* Pattern-Driven Thinking — A disciplined approach to applying the right software design patterns to build maintainable, scalable solutions.
* Data Fluency — Comfort working across both relational and NoSQL paradigms, choosing the right database approach for the problem at hand.
* Collaborative Nature — A team-first attitude and clear communication style when working across frontend, backend, and infrastructure disciplines.
* Quality Mindset — A strong commitment to writing tested, reviewed, and production-ready code at every layer of the stack.
* Problem-Solving Drive — A proactive, analytical approach to diagnosing and resolving issues across the full technology stack.
* Growth Mindset — An eagerness to stay current with evolving technologies, frameworks, and best practices across frontend and backend ecosystems.

We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. title: Software Engineer (Full Stack
description:
Software Engineer (Full Stack)
  
  
Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment?" and "when will I get it?" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc.
  
  
You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance.
  
  
Here are some of the things the role involves:
  
  

* Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build.
* Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft.
* Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems.
* Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time.
* Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that don't degrade the originally intended user experience.
* While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering

performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other.
  
  

* While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up.
* Work with Maersk's design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them.
* Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks.
* Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting.
* Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be.
* Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures.

**About You**
Here are some things we expect from you for the role.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding.
* Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data.
* Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it.
* Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes.
* Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output,and recognising when they are going wrong.
* Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always

maintaining high test coverage for any code written.
  
  

* Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them.
* Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts.
* Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS.
* Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node.js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies.
* Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go.
* Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently.
* Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other.
* Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously.
* Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications.
* Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form.
* Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We're hiring an SDE-2 Full Stack Engineer to build the web experiences adjusters and policyholders use to report, track, and settle insurance claims. You'll spend most of your time on the frontend in React and TypeScript — owning features end to end from design handoff to production — while understanding and contributing to the backend services that power them.
  
  
Our claims services are written largely in Go, so Go experience is a strong plus, though solid backend fundamentals in any language are what matter most. We're also building a desktop application in Electron, so Electron experience is a real plus. You'll design APIs alongside backend engineers, reason about data models, and understand how your UI behaves under real production load.
  
  
This is a mid-level role for someone who ships independently, raises the bar on frontend quality, and wants to learn the claims domain deeply. The people using what you build are often filing a claim on a bad day or working through a high-volume queue — thoughtful, reliable UX matters here.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Frontend features across the claims lifecycle: claim intimation, claim status tracking, document and photo upload, adjuster workbench tools, and settlement flows
* Translating designs into accessible, responsive, performant UI, and partnering with design and product on usability
* API design with backend engineers, and contributions to Go services when a feature needs an endpoint, a data model change, or a fix
* Integrations with third-party vendor APIs — surveyors, garages/repairers, hospitals or TPAs, payment gateways, document verification — including error handling, retries, and graceful degradation when a vendor is slow or down
* Frontend observability: error tracking, performance monitoring, user-journey analytics, and alerting so we know when a claims flow breaks before customers tell us
* Test coverage and observability for everything you ship — unit, integration, and end-to-end

**Who You Are**

* You take a feature from ambiguous requirement to production without waiting to be told each step
* You explain technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product, and design, in writing and in conversation
* You debug across the stack — browser, API, database — and fix root causes, not symptoms
* You review others' code generously, ask for review on your own, and help junior engineers level up

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on frontend development
* Strong command of React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, including state management, component architecture, and performance tuning
* Solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, hands-on Tailwind CSS experience, accessibility (WCAG) awareness, and experience building responsive, cross-browser UI
* Working knowledge of backend systems: REST or gRPC API design, relational databases and SQL, authentication/authorization, and how services are deployed and monitored
* Hands-on backend experience in at least one server-side language (Go preferred; Java, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar also fine)
* Experience writing automated tests at multiple levels
* Experience integrating third-party APIs into a product, and instrumenting frontend code with error tracking and performance monitoring

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or shipping Electron desktop applications: packaging, auto-updates, main/renderer process communication, and native OS integration
* Production experience with Go: writing services, concurrency patterns, testing, and the standard toolchain
* Experience in another regulated domain (fintech, healthcare, banking) where auditability, data privacy, and compliance shape product decisions
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures, message queues, or workflow engines
* Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, and CI/CD
* Exposure to applied AI/ML features in product — document classification, intake triage, or LLM-backed assistants

Full Stack. Full Data. Full AI. Deliver More—Together.
  
  
At mindZvue, our Full Stack Engineers build the products and platforms that power an AI-native consultancy — from SaaS products and internal AI platforms to GenAI solutions embedded in client ecosystems. This role sits at the intersection of modern web engineering, data, and large language models: you'll ship features in the morning, wire up an LLM pipeline in the afternoon, and see it used by real users the same week.
  
  
If you're the engineer who's already building with AI — not waiting for permission to — come build with us.

Experience & Expertise

* Demonstrable experience building with LLM APIs or GenAI frameworks — production features, internal tools, or serious side projects.

* Strong grasp of Git, CI/CD, testing, and observability.

Mindset & Soft Skills
  
  

* Product mindset — you care about the user, not just the code.
* Bias for shipping: pragmatic, iterative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
* Clear written and verbal communication in a distributed team.

**Benefits**

We are a
**Salesforce Summit (Platinum) Partner**
,
**Great Place to Work® Certified**
, and
**ISO-certified**
organization — and we are building one of the most

in the ecosystem.
  
  
At mindZvue, AI is not a buzzword on a slide — it is how we work every day:
  
  

* AI-Assisted Engineering — Our teams build with AI pair-programming as a standard part of the delivery toolkit, shipping faster with higher quality.
* Agentforce & GenAI Practice — We design and deliver Agentforce agents, Data Cloud, and GenAI-powered customer experiences for global enterprises.

.

**Join Us! CDM Smith – where amazing career journeys unfold.**

**Job Description**
CDM Smith is seeking a Full Stack Application Developer to join our Digital Engineering Solutions team. As a member of the Digital Engineering Solutions team, the Development group will also engage in research and development and provide guidance and oversight to the AEC practices at CDM Smith, engaging in new product research, testing, and the incubation of innovative ideas that arise from around the company. The ideal candidate should possess an extensive background in application development, that includes security, scaling, integration, and application migration, along with a commitment to continuous advancement and interest that drives measurable results. The following are the Key responsibilities for this position
  
  

* Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from the initial concept and design phase to the implementation and support phase.
* Take responsibility of the project and operate independently within a collaborative environment.
* Understanding storyboards, wireframes, mockups, and basic prototypes, and translating them into tangible solutions.
* Involve in the design and recommendation of the project framework, which includes the system, technical, and security architecture.
* Use Agile development techniques while ensuring that the code is scalable, reusable, and of high quality.
* Solid understanding of Azure pipelines and DevSecOps methodologies.
* Deliver efficient solutions to address problems needed to meet business requirements.
* Investigate third-party libraries and integrate software components while working with teams from different business units to meet their prototype and development needs.
* Conduct research across various disciplines, including IT systems, design, development, deployment, networking, servers, endpoints, hardware/software, and third-party vendor services.
* Maintain awareness of market trends and upcoming technology, pursue necessary training and certifications, and share insights to the team.
* Addressing complex challenges, possessing a deep comprehension of diverse software technologies and architectural design, as well as expertise in planning, configuring, and managing resources within Microsoft Azure.
* Accountable for the development of best practices, the inventive resolution of technical issues, the prioritization of tasks, and the ability to multitask.
* Demonstrate exceptional time management abilities, an extensive understanding of task assignments and schedules, and the effective utilization of available resources and time. Skills and Abilities: Experience with the following:
* Extensive experience in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile Development, and Programming methodologies.
* Solid understanding of the architecture patterns based on MVC, MVVM, and SPA.
* Proficient in Designing, developing, and maintaining web applications with.NET languages (C#, VB.NET) and technologies (ASP.NET, .NET Core).
* Developing user interfaces that are both responsive and engaging by utilizing popular frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js, as well as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript libraries such as jQuery and Bootstrap.
* Building and ingesting web services, such as RESTful APIs, to improve communication between the client-side and server-side components.
* Developing efficient data access code with Entity Framework or ADO.NET and implementing data storage solutions using structure and unstructured databases services.
* Implementing optimal coding, testing, and deployment methodologies to guarantee application security, scalability, and performance.
* Establishing and achieving project milestones in collaboration with cross-functional teams comprising designers, project managers, and other developers.
* Writing code that is well-documented, maintainable, and orderly to facilitate the development of applications and future iterations.
* Conducting code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing to identify and resolve bugs prior to deployment.
* Enhancing the functionality and performance of applications by keeping up with the most recent advancements in the.NET framework and other web technologies.
* Working experience with OWASP security principles, comprehension of accessibility, and security compliance tools.
* Proficiency in security authentication technologies (e.g., OAuth2.0, JWT), Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM), and Identity & Access Management (IAM)
* Pursuing continuous learning and professional growth to adjust to changing technological trends and full-stack development best practices.
* Competent in version control practices with git, including branching, collaboration, reviewing pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. (GitHub, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Providing technical assistance and direction to other team members and stakeholders, including troubleshooting and resolving difficulties after deployment.

**Skills & Abilities**
Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex IT concepts in an understandable manner. Possesses excellent attention to detail. Excels at diagnosing and solving complex technical problems across the entire development stack. Possesses excellent skills in managing data efficiently across systems, applying strategies for data storage, retrieval, and processing. Possesses solid knowledge and understanding of business metrics and the ability to align company goals and objectives with development strategies and initiatives. Demonstrates excellent understanding of user interface and user experience (UI/UX) principles. Consistent ability to work effectively across all levels in a highly dynamic environment. Demonstrates a proactive approach to innovation by identifying and applying emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and process optimization.

* 5+ years of related work experience.
* Azure certifications AZ-900/AZ-204 and accreditation preferred.

**Amount Of Travel Required**

**Background Check and Drug Testing Information**
CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries (hereafter collectively referred to as “CDM Smith”) reserves the right to require background checks including criminal, employment, education, licensure, etc. as well as credit and motor vehicle when applicable for certain positions. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. In addition, during employment individuals may be required by CDM Smith or a CDM Smith client to successfully complete additional background checks, including motor vehicle record as well as drug testing.

title: Controls Tech - EIM - Java Full Stack Tech Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Java Fullstack Tech Lead (C13 - Vice President) to lead the design, development, and delivery of mission-critical, enterprise-scale applications within Citi. In this role, you will lead high-performing engineering squads, architect robust microservices and modern UI solutions, drive adoption of cloud-native and DevOps best practices, and collaborate closely with product management, business stakeholders, and enterprise architecture teams to deliver resilient, high-throughput financial systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Core Expectations**

* Architectural Design & Technical Leadership Own end-to-end technical solution architecture, translating complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable, fault-tolerant, and maintainable software designs. Champion modern software paradigms including event-driven architectures (EDA), domain-driven design (DDD), asynchronous messaging, and reactive systems. Ensure all technical designs strictly align with Citi’s enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity principles, and non-functional requirements (NFRs).
* Fullstack Engineering Excellence (Java & Modern UI) Architect and lead the implementation of resilient backend services using Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices patterns. Drive modern, modular, accessible, and responsive frontend applications using React, Angular, or TypeScript, enforcing component reusability and high UI performance. Set rigorous engineering standards across the tech stack, ensuring clean code, SOLID principles, optimal algorithm design, and minimal technical debt.
* Cloud-Native Architecture & Containerization Drive migration and modernization of services toward cloud platforms (OpenShift / AWS / GCP / Private Cloud / Hybrid). Oversee containerization strategies using Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes / OpenShift (ECS), ensuring auto-scaling, high availability, and disaster recovery readiness. Architect multi-region, active-active, or active-passive deployment patterns to guarantee business continuity (COB/DR).
* API & Integration Engineering Design and govern enterprise-grade RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and gRPC interfaces following OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Architect asynchronous, event-driven data streaming pipelines leveraging Apache Kafka, Solace, or IBM MQ. Implement secure API gateway controls, rate-limiting, mutual TLS (mTLS), token-based authentication (OAuth2/OIDC), and circuit-breaking patterns.
* Data Architecture & Persistence Engineering Lead database design, query optimization, indexing, and data modeling across relational engines (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/Document databases (MongoDB, Cassandra). Implement distributed caching mechanisms using Redis or Hazelcast to optimize response latencies and system throughput. Ensure strict adherence to data governance, lineage, retention, and masking policies for sensitive financial data.
* DevSecOps, CI/CD, & Quality Engineering Automation Champion automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using platforms like Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab/GitHub Actions, and Harness. Enforce automated test-driven development (TDD), behavior-driven development (BDD), and integration testing using JUnit 5, Mockito, Cypress, Playwright, or Jest. Mandate static and dynamic security scanning (Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Black Duck) with zero-tolerance policies for high-severity vulnerabilities.
* Observability, Resiliency, & Site Reliability Implement comprehensive telemetry, metrics, distributed tracing, and centralized logging utilizing OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK/Loki. Drive site reliability engineering (SRE) practices, setting and monitoring Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, conducting blameless post-mortems and implementing preventative corrective actions.
* Engineering Governance, Risk, & Regulatory Compliance Ensure all software deliverables comply with Citi's internal development lifecycle standards, Citi Information Security Policies (CISP), and regulatory compliance guidelines (e.g., SOX, Basel, GDPR). Prepare applications for internal and external audits, architecture review boards (ARB), and threat modeling assessments. Manage risk identification, remediation tracking, and technical mitigation across all owned repositories and systems.
* Team Leadership, Mentorship, & Talent Development Function as technical mentor and coach for engineers (C09–C12), conducting rigorous code reviews, pair programming, and technical workshops. Foster a culture of innovation, psychological safety, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across geographically distributed squads. Partner with Engineering Managers on technical hiring, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development roadmaps.
* Agile Execution & Stakeholder Collaboration Collaborate actively with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, and Operations teams in PI planning, backlog grooming, and sprint executions. Translate business roadmaps into granular technical user stories, estimation models, and phased release strategies. Communicate technical concepts, project risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to senior management and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Full Stack Lead Engineer
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?

If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
  
  
We want to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack.
  
  
**About Us**
At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money.
  
  
Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform.
  
  
Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights.
  
  
**Modulr values**

* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.

**The Role**
The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead
  
  
the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams.
  
  
**Specific duties**

* Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices.
* Technically efficient to write production-quality Python code, designing high-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards.
* Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues.
* Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend & frontend through 1-2-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression.
* Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking.
* Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend.
* Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy.
* Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values.
* Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation.

**About You**
**Must Have**
:
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in Python (9+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices.
* Strong, hands-on experience with FastAPI, including building high-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations.
* Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full-stack integration and frontend-backend communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc).
* Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes.
* Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud-native application patterns.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations.
* Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision-making in a collaborative environment.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.

**Good to have:**

* Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing.
* Experience in the fintech or payments domain.

**Key Attributes:**

* Strong problem-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies.
* Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems.
* Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions.

**ModInclusion**
At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.
  
  
Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker
