The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices.
* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service.
* Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations.
* Build custom solutions using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.
* Design and implement scalable integrations using Azure and Power Platform capabilities.
* Oversee system architecture, performance tuning, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment to ensure optimal functionality and user experience.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to team members, fostering collaboration and high-quality delivery.
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear and actionable discussions.
* Participate in project planning, sprint ceremonies, estimations, and delivery governance using Agile methodologies.
* Stay current with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform advancements, recommending continuous improvements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM configuration, customization, and solution delivery.
* Proficiency in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS with hands-on experience in plugins and workflows.
* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes.
* Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.
* Proven problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to quality and performance.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in collaborative, Agile teams.
* Developed and customized AI Copilots and agents using Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 CRM, integrating workflows, Dataverse, and APIs to support intelligent automation and conversational experiences.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
  
  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
IT&S Group
  
  
**Job Description**
**You will work with**
You will lead a high-energy, top-performing team of engineers and product managers, working alongside technology and business leaders to shape the vision and drive the execution of progressive platform initiatives that make a real impact.
  
  
**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
The Senior Enterprise Technology Engineer provides engineering leadership across bp's digital landscape, connecting squads with bp's platforms and engineering capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and resilient solutions aligned to business strategy. They lead end-to-end technical delivery, ensure engineering integrity at scale, and actively manage delivery and technical risk while guiding teams through complex build challenges.
  
  
Operating as a hands-on technical leader with strong customer and stakeholder influence, they balance long-term engineering excellence with near-term delivery outcomes, empowering squads to make sound technical decisions and fostering a unified, pragmatic, and sustainable engineering culture across bp.
  
  
This role will play a key leadership position in delivering modern B2B customer portal and commerce capabilities, working closely with customer engagement platforms, product teams, architecture teams, SAP teams, and engineering squads to maximise reuse of shared platform capabilities and accelerate delivery through modern composable architecture principles.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
**Technology**
Leads a team of enterprise engineers to design, develop, and deliver high-quality platforms and services. Acts as a hands-on technical authority on bp's platforms, languages, and frameworks, including Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns. Drives squad goals, prioritises initiatives, and delivers in a product-led, empowered environment. Guides modernisation of legacy estates to unlock future capabilities.
  
  
**Delivery & Transformation**
Owns end-to-end delivery of complex B2B commerce and customer portal transformation programmes, from discovery through build, migration, cutover, and hypercare. Manages delivery risk, sequencing, and dependencies across squads, vendors, and SI partners. Ensures legacy-to-modern transitions are planned for coexistence, data migration, and minimal business disruption.
  
  
Drives adoption of MACH and composable architecture principles, ensuring alignment with strategic customer engagement platforms through reuse of shared capabilities, APIs, services, and design patterns.
  
  
**Data**
Engineers data-intensive solutions and integration flows across enterprise systems. Builds secure, governed, and interoperable data pipelines with strong quality, lineage, and observability. Designs and governs API-led and event-driven integration architectures using REST, GraphQL, OData, SAP integration patterns, and enterprise messaging solutions.
  
  
**Commercial Awareness**
Applies engineering insight to cost and value priorities, including cloud spend and TCO. Evaluates tools and platforms for fit, resilience, and lock-in risk to inform build-vs-buy decisions.
  
  
**Safety, Security & Compliance**
Embeds secure-by-design practices and supports audit, licensing, and compliance obligations as part of routine delivery.
  
  
**Collaboration & Influence**
Acts as a technical expert, providing guidance and support to the squad and wider engineering community. Communicates clearly with team members, partners, and customers. Represents engineering in governance and design forums to resolve technical trade-offs.
  
  
Leads and governs delivery partners, system integrators, and product vendors, ensuring architectural and engineering standards are upheld across the extended delivery ecosystem.
  
  
Works closely with Product, UX, Architecture, SAP, Integration, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align with strategic platform roadmaps and maximise reuse of common capabilities and technical assets.
  
  
**Building Teams**
Shapes squad structures, tech-lead roles, and engineering capacity for complex programmes. Develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration.
  
  
**Growing People**
Mentors engineers across grades and supports succession planning. Promotes standard methodologies, maintainable code, clear documentation, and high-quality work.
  
  
**Change Leadership**
Leads engineering transformation and adoption of modern practices, including DevSecOps, SRE, platform engineering, cloud-native delivery, composable architecture, and AI-assisted development. Ensures quality in enterprise platform engineering at the squad level and owns the engineering narrative for change.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**What you will need to be successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, security, and operations in large-scale global environments, with 4+ years in a technical leadership role delivering cloud-native, MACH (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless), composable architecture, and customer-facing digital platform solutions.
* Strong experience building, leading, and running high-performance engineering teams, with a focus on reliability, automation, operational excellence, and customer success.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL, Agile, DevSecOps, and enterprise technology governance frameworks.
* Hands-on software engineering experience, including test driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality management, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of B2B commerce and customer portal capabilities, including Product Catalog Management, Product Modelling, Inventory Availability, Shopping Cart and Checkout, Order Management, Search and Browse, SEO, and Personalisation.
* Strong experience integrating customer engagement and commerce platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA using IDoc, BAPI, OData, RFC, SAP CPI/BTP, APIs, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Strong technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, JavaScript, relational databases, microservices, BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) patterns, API orchestration, API gateways, and modern distributed system design.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering modern web applications using React, reusable component architectures, responsive design, GraphQL, and headless front-end architectures.
* Experience delivering cloud-native applications on Azure and/or AWS using containers, Kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure automation, observability, and DevSecOps pipelines.
* Experience implementing enterprise security solutions including OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Azure AD, SSO, and role-based access control.
* Experience working with Git-based source control, modern software delivery practices, and engineering lifecycle management.
* Experience leading delivery through vendor and SI partner ecosystems, holding partners accountable for engineering quality, timelines, architecture compliance, and delivery outcomes.
* Experience designing and delivering global, multi-country, multi-currency, and multi-language B2B commerce and customer portal solutions.
* Experience within the Energy, Oil & Gas, or other complex enterprise industries is an advantage.

**Essential Skills**

* Deep expertise in designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and resilient distributed systems.
* Strong experience delivering B2B customer portals and commerce solutions using MACH (Microservices, API-First, Cloud-Native, Headless) and composable architecture principles.
* Deep technical expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, API-led integration, and event-driven architectures within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms with SAP ERP/S/4HANA and other business-critical systems using modern integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native delivery on Azure and/or AWS, including infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, operational readiness, and lifecycle ownership.
* Proven experience in reliability engineering, incident management, disaster recovery, application performance monitoring, and operational excellence for business-critical platforms.
* Experience delivering solutions spanning custom-built software, configured platforms, and third-party integrations at enterprise scale.
* Experience establishing engineering standards, architecture governance, reusable platform capabilities, and engineering best practices across multiple squads.
* Strong ability to resolve technical trade-offs across squads, platforms, vendors, and stakeholders while balancing delivery, architecture, and business priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, UX, Architecture, Platform Engineering, SAP, and business teams to deliver customerfocused solutions.

**Desirable Skills**

title: Android SE 2 - Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Location**
- Pune

**Software Engineer 2 –**
Android Full Stack Engineer

**About the company**

Helpshift - A Keywords Studio, bridges the disconnect between conventional customer service channels — such as email and phone support — and a growing consumer base that does more on mobile phones and has a strong preference for messaging as the primary mode of communication. Through Helpshift’s AI-powered customer service platform, companies can resolve issues more efficiently, boosting customer satisfaction in the process. Companies such as Supercell, Scopely, Rovio, and hundreds of other leading brands use the Helpshift platform to provide messaging-first customer support. Helpshift is installed on two billion devices worldwide and serves more than 820 million active consumers. We are looking for an ambitious, experienced, driven & solution orientated individual that thrives in a fast-paced, cutting-edge, technology-driven environment. You will be an integral part of our custom development and professional services team and collaborating with multiple teams to deliver solutions to our clients.

Keywords Studios continues to build world leading capabilities in services that video game and similar interactive content creators need. We stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients working as their external partner, providing access to our teams of experts where and when needed.

People that work at Keywords are passionate, talented, committed, and resourceful. Human talent is our most valuable resource and as a business, we thrive on diversity, celebrate uniqueness and work as teams whether we are physically together in one of our 70+ studios around the world or working together virtually.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Software Engineer 2 who combines strong Android development expertise with solid experience in either backend or frontend systems. You will own end-to-end features that span mobile clients and the supporting web or service layer, working closely with Product Managers to turn high-level requirements into production-ready solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional experience in Android development and/or backend/frontend engineering
* Hands-on experience shipping production Android applications
* Solid understanding of modern Android architecture and tooling
* Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale systems or high-traffic dashboards.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Android**

* Strong command of Java, MVVM architecture and clean code practices.
* Deep familiarity with Activities, Fragments, and WebViews
* Production experience with network layers (Retrofit/OkHttp or equivalent), WebSockets, and efficient data handling.
* Deep expertise in FCM Push Notifications and other optimal data fetching mechanisms.
* Proficiency with the Gradle build system, dependency management, and multi-module projects
* Experience shipping apps to production (Play Store or enterprise distribution)
* Proficiency in using AI tools for accelerated development workflows.
* Hybrid app development experience with platforms like ReactNative/Unity/Cocos2dx etc.

**Backend or Frontend (one track required)**

* Backend track: Experience designing and operating large-scale systems, API design, data modeling, and cloud deployment (preferably AWS)
* Frontend track: Experience building high-traffic dashboards or web applications using React (or similar), modern JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, and deployment platforms such as Vercel
* Comfort working across the stack when needed (e.g., integrating Android clients with backend services or embedding web content)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Product Managers to gather, clarify, and refine requirements, then break them into well-scoped features and technical tasks
* Design, implement, and maintain Android features while ensuring clean architecture, testability, and performance
* Contribute to backend services or frontend dashboards that support the mobile product (depending on your primary secondary skill)
* Own existing features end-to-end: monitoring, debugging, optimization, and iterative improvements
* Write high-quality, maintainable code with appropriate unit, integration, and UI tests
* Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical design documents
* Collaborate with designers, QA, and other engineers to deliver polished, reliable experiences
* Identify technical debt and propose pragmatic improvements that balance velocity and long-term health
* Mentor more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing
* Contribute to team processes around CI/CD, release management, and observability

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, or modern Android UI frameworks
* Familiarity with real-time systems (WebSockets, push notifications, background work)
* Exposure to infrastructure-as-code, monitoring/observability tools, or performance optimization at scale
* Prior experience in a product-driven, cross-functional team environment

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months you will have independently delivered meaningful features across Android and the supporting backend/frontend layer, improved the reliability or performance of existing systems, and become a trusted technical partner to Product and Engineering leadership.

title: Application Engineering, Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who gets energized by the moment when a piece of software you built actually clicks for the person using it. Not when it compiles without errors, but when an engineer on the other side of the world opens your application and their workflow just got easier. You have learned that the hardest part of building useful tools is not the technical implementation, it is understanding what people are actually trying to accomplish.
   

  

 You think in systems, but you communicate in plain language. When a customer describes a problem, you can hold the technical architecture in your head while also tracking what they really need versus what they think they need. You ask clarifying questions that get to the root without making people feel interrogated.
   

  

 You do not wait for perfect information before you start building. You sketch out a solution, validate the approach with the people who will use it, and iterate based on what you learn. When something does not work the way you expected, you dig into why instead of just trying a different approach and hoping it sticks.
   

  

 You care about craft. You write code that someone else can pick up six months from now and understand. You document not because someone told you to, but because you know that good documentation is a gift to your future self and everyone who comes after you.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will find a place where the applications you build get used by engineers solving real problems.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Design and build full stack web applications using Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS that integrate simulation technologies into customer engineering workflows
* Develop backend services and RESTful APIs that connect frontend interfaces to Python\-based automation engines, including PyAnsys libraries where applicable
* Work directly with customers and internal Synopsys teams to translate engineering requirements into working web solutions that fit their actual use cases
* Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, improve UI/UX prototyping, debug more effectively, and increase test coverage
* Contribute to code reviews, write clear documentation, and help maintain code quality standards across development projects
* Participate in technical demos and customer presentations to show case solutions, gather feedback, and support adoption of new capabilities


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* You will deliver web applications that make complex simulation workflows accessible and usable for engineers who depend on them to meet project deadlines
* Your backend services and APIs will enable automation that saves customers hours of manual configuration and data handling per project cycle
* The solutions you build will directly influence how customers adopt and scale simulation\-driven design processes across their engineering teams
* Your collaboration with product teams will surface real\-world usage patterns that shape roadmap priorities and improve tool usability based on actual customer needs
* Your containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines will reduce release cycles and improve reliability for customer\-facing solutions
* You will bridge the gap between advanced simulation technology and practical engineering workflows, making powerful capabilities accessible to users who are not simulation experts
* Your contributions to code quality and documentation will raise development standards for the team and accelerate onboarding for future engineers


 What You'll Need
   

  

* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 2\+ years of professional software development experience, or a Master's degree with relevant project or internship experience
* You bring strong proficiency in Python for backend development, including hands\-on experience with Python\-based web or UI frameworks
* You have working knowledge of frontend development concepts and UI/UX principles, with the ability to translate user needs into functional interfaces that people actually want to use
* You are comfortable using Git for version control in a collaborative team environment where multiple people are working in the same codebase
* You have a solid understanding of core backend and infrastructure concepts, including RESTful API design, network fundamentals, and database systems, enabling you to effectively contribute to robust, full\-stack application development.
* You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and can explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without losing the important details
* Experience with the Ansys software ecosystem ,PyAnsys, or similar scientific and engineering application domains is a plus, as is familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can sit with a customer or internal stakeholder, listen to what they are trying to accomplish, and walk away with enough clarity to start building without needing every detail spelled out in advance
* When you review code or see a UI that does not quite work, you speak up with specific suggestions instead of just noting that something feels off, and you do it in a way that helps the team move forward
* You manage multiple threads at once without dropping details, a bug fix, a new feature request, and a deployment can all be in flight and you know exactly where each one stands
* You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adjusting your communication style so that nothing gets lost in translation and everyone stays aligned
* You test your own work thoroughly before handing it off because you know that catching issues early saves everyone time downstream and builds trust with the people depending on your code
* You are genuinely curious about how simulation and engineering tools get used in the real world, and that curiosity makes you ask better questions and build better solutions


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Ansys Customer Excellence team, working at the intersection of engineering simulation, modern software platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions. This is a technical role where you will collaborate with customers, internal product teams, and engineers across geographies to shape how simulation technologies are integrated into scalable, cloud\-native platforms. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current initiatives, and collaboration model during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
**Senior Full Stack AI Engineer — Agentic**
**Location and working model:** 
 Pune, India — hybrid. Minimum three hours of daily overlap with US Central time.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5\+ years in engineering, including at least 1 year building LLM\-backed products that ran in production.
   

  

 Role overview
   

  

 We is building enterprise\-grade software solutions that combine modern web engineering, cloud platforms and production\-grade AI capabilities. This is a senior hands\-on role anchoring agentic development: you will design and build LLM\-powered agents, establish the reusable engineering patterns other engineers build against, and set the standard for how non\-deterministic systems are evaluated. Mentoring and design contribution beyond your own features are core to the role, not occasional extras.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Anchor the hands\-on build of LLM\-powered agents — reasoning loops, planning, tool and function calling, retries, fallbacks and guardrails.
* Establish reusable agent engineering patterns and shared libraries that other engineers build against.
* Define and implement evaluation for agent behaviour: how quality is proven before release and how regression is detected afterwards.
* Build retrieval and structured data access over large corpora to support agent reasoning. � Instrument agents for observability — tracing, token accounting and cost attribution.
* Contribute to design reviews across the wider engineering group and review other engineers' agent work.
* Mentor engineers on agentic patterns and on responsible AI\-assisted development, defining review, testing and traceability standards for AI\-generated changes so unverified or architecture\-breaking code does not reach the codebase.
* Integrate agent capability with surrounding platform services, including administration, access control and workflow.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Deep production Python — async patterns, queues, structured outputs, and the discipline to make non\-deterministic systems testable.
* Hands\-on experience with an agent framework (for example LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI or AutoGen, or an in\-house equivalent) and with function and tool calling.
* Prompt design paired with evaluation: you can explain how you measured whether an agent worked, not only how you built it.
* Retrieval\-augmented generation or structured retrieval over a large corpus.
* Observability for LLM systems — tracing, token accounting and regression suites for agent behaviour.
* Demonstrated mentoring: pairing, design review and visibly raising the standard of the engineers around you.
* Disciplined use of AI coding assistants within defined engineering and security guardrails: you independently validate generated code, verify it through unit, integration and regression tests, check maintainability, architecture alignment, security, privacy, licensing and performance, and never treat generated output as production\-ready without human review. You can explain and defend any code you submit.
* Comfortable with ambiguity — agent behaviour is established empirically rather than specified up front.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Full stack range — able to build the interfaces that expose agent capability.
* QA or test\-automation domain knowledge.
* Experience with browser automation or DOM analysis libraries. � Cost and performance optimization for LLM workloads.

title: Senior Engineer- Software Development
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with 5\+ years of experience building full\-stack solutions using .NET Core for backend services and TypeScript with ReactJS/Next.js for modern web frontends, paired with deep expertise in AWS technologies — including DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, and S3\. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading projects, actively contributing to sprint design, and mentoring team members, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, scalable, and efficient software across the full stack.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Software Development**
 Design, code, and implement full\-stack software solutions using .NET Core (backend/APIs) and TypeScript\-based ReactJS/Next.js (frontend). Develop high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable applications end to end.
   

  

**Technical Design and Architecture**
 Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to define technical vision, system architecture, and integration of AWS services and frontend frameworks. Contribute to the design of software components, ensuring scalability, performance, and adherence to best practices — including serverless\-first patterns where appropriate.
   

  

**AWS Services Integration**
 Utilize AWS services such as DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, S3, and others to design and implement robust, efficient, serverless solutions. Integrate applications with these services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

**Frontend Engineering**
 Build responsive, performant, type\-safe user interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Next.js (SSR/SSG, App Router, API routes). Ensure clean integration between frontend applications and .NET Core/serverless backends.
   

  

**Database Integration**
 Design and optimize database schemas and queries for efficient data storage and retrieval in DynamoDB. Integrate and synchronize data across databases and AWS services.
   

  

**Testing and Quality Assurance**
 Write unit and integration tests, conduct code reviews, and enforce coding standards across backend and frontend code. Build and maintain automated test coverage. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and resolve issues.
   

  

**CI/CD and DevOps**
 Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments, supporting serverless deployments (Lambda, S3, CloudFormation/CDK/Serverless Framework).
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Stay current with .NET Core, TypeScript, React/Next.js, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tooling. Identify opportunities for process improvement, code optimization, and enhanced developer workflows — including adopting AI coding assistants to boost team velocity and code quality.
   

  

**Collaboration and Leadership**
 Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to align development efforts with requirements. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers across both backend and frontend disciplines.
   

  

**Troubleshooting and Support**
 Investigate and resolve complex technical issues in development and production. Support end users/clients to ensure smooth operation of applications.
   

  

**What do you need to know?**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with .NET Core, with strong AWS\-based project experience.
* Working experience with TypeScript, ReactJS, and Next.js for building production frontend applications.
* Expertise in AWS services, including DynamoDB, EventBridge, and Lambda; solid understanding of S3 and serverless architectures.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitLab CI.
* Proven track record of leading projects and delivering high\-quality software solutions end to end.
* Deep understanding of software development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across full\-stack applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills across distributed, serverless systems.
* Excellent mentoring and leadership abilities, with a passion for developing junior engineers.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience working in an Agile environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.


**Good to have**
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate coding, code review, and testing workflows.
* Experience designing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines for serverless and containerized deployments.
* Experience with Playwright (or similar) for end\-to\-end and browser automation testing.
* AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, are highly desirable.

DevSecOps), Threat and Controls Assessment (inc. threat modelling) and Third Party Security Assessment. The function drives the identification, capture, assessment, testing/verification and ultimately the remediation of security defects, gaps and vulnerabilities across HSBC’s estate in conjunction with business and technology teams – on\-premise, within the Cloud and for those resulting from third party engagements.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* You’ll lead the technical delivery of full stack services and integrations used by internal cybersecurity stakeholders—covering REST APIs, data pipelines/ETL, CI/CD, and service operability—using HSBC’s CSAT engineering approach: Python\-first, microservice principles, containers, and DevSecOps. You’ll also shape “how we do things” within the team through pragmatic standards, patterns and automation—borrowing the best elements of a principal engineering mindset without being the enterprise\-wide authority.
* The role will partner heavily with cybersecurity experts across CSAT to deliver solutions that help keep the bank secure. Such solutions can include the integration and automation of third\-party scanning tools such that they periodically detect for vulnerabilities across the estate, and report these back to relevant stakeholders. Other solutions can include building in\-house scanning capabilities that look for certain types of security weaknesses.
* As a Senior Tech Lead, your responsibilities will include the following: Technical delivery \& team leadership\- Lead technical design and delivery for a pod/squad in an agile/DevSecOps environment, partnering closely with the Product Owners and Global Head of Engineering.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction: break down work, define technical approaches, unblock engineers, and ensure quality outcomes. Remain hands\-on in development (expected to contribute code regularly) across backend, pipelines and automation.
* Solution design (secure\-by\-design): Design and evolve loosely coupled microservices and internal platforms supporting cyber use\-cases such as: automation/integration of third\-party scanning tools, in\-house scanning capabilities, workflow and reporting services for vulnerability management and assurance, Apply and coach modern patterns aligned to the existing stack, including microservices and event based systems where appropriate.
* DevSecOps, reliability \& automation : Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) to reduce friction and increase reliability. Drive a strong operability culture: L2/L3 troubleshooting, incident hygiene, release discipline, technical documentation, and measurable service health. Drive the remediation of problem actions following incidents. Drive the team to deliver high quality observability in everything they build, from the very beginning.
* AI solutions \& AI\-assisted engineering: Build AI\-enabled features/services (e.g., triage, classification, summarisation, anomaly detection, prioritisation) where they measurably improve cyber outcomes. Champion responsible use of AI coding tools (e.g., pair\-programming assistants) with guardrails: secure coding, data handling, code review expectations, and testing standards. Introduce repeatable team practices to accelerate delivery with AI (prompt patterns, evaluation approaches, secure usage guidance, and CI checks).
* Engineering excellence (team\-level) : Establish pragmatic standards and patterns for your squad: code quality, testing, branching strategy, service templates, reusable libraries.Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and peer reviews; lead by example.


**To be successful , you need to have**
* Strong, proven experience delivering production services in Python, with modern web frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask/Django also relevant). Demonstrable experience designing and delivering REST API services, integrations to third\-party products, and internal end\-user services.
* Solid experience with microservice architecture and practical application of distributed systems patterns. Strong hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes deployments. Strong CI/CD engineering experience (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab) including automated tests and release pipelines.
* Strong Linux administration and core networking knowledge. Proficiency with Git and branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow or trunk\-based). Strong SQL skills (complex queries). Confidence leading technical delivery: making design decisions, guiding others, and raising engineering standards through reviews and mentoring.
* Experience building AI\-enabled software (e.g., using ML/NLP services, LLM\-based components, or applied AI workflows) and using AI coding tools in a professional engineering environment with quality controls.
* Working style \& behaviours : Clear communicator who can translate between engineers and non\-engineers in a global team. Comfortable moving at pace while operating safely in a highly regulated environment. Inclusive leader who supports different perspectives and helps the team succeed together.
* Great to have (i.e. what would really help you standout): Cybersecurity engineering experience (e.g., SAST/DAST integration, pen testing concepts, fuzzing, threat detection/exploitation techniques).
* Cloud platform delivery experience (AWS/Azure/GCP), Terraform, and operational monitoring (e.g., Prometheus) and/or service mesh. Strong front\-end experience (e.g., React) beyond baseline HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
* Experience with relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MSSQL, MongoDB) including performance tuning. Experience with message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).

 As a growing team, we’re building scalable infrastructure and systems to support our platform (for ourselves and our customers), and we are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can help make everything robust, automated, secure, and efficient.

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Senior Full Stack Developer** 
 with a
 **minimum of 5 years**

NEW OPPORTUNITY \|\| IMMEDIATE TO 30 DAYS JOINERS REQUIRED \|\|
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 Lead / Manager, Full Stack Development – Cloud \& IoT Platforms
 



  





**Experience:** 
 10\-15 Years
 



  





**Location:** 
 Pune, Onsite
 



  





  





**About Job Role** 




 We are seeking a hands\-on Full Stack Development Lead/Manager, with 10\-15 years of software engineering experience to lead and contribute directly to the architecture, development, deployment, and lifecycle support of scalable cloud\-connected applications. This is a player\-coach role: the successful candidate will lead a team of engineers while remaining technically hands\-on across backend services, web applications, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, real\-time data pipelines, and production troubleshooting.
 



 The role will be central to building highly available digital platforms for remote supervision, configuration, health monitoring, control, telemetry, and event\-driven alerting across connected field devices and gateways. Solutions must support secure, low\-latency interaction between cloud applications and IoT / edge systems used in fire, life\-safety, paging, and emergency communication environments, where reliability, traceability, resilience, and security are critical.
 



 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Engineering Leadership \& Delivery
 



 • Lead, mentor, and develop a full stack engineering team, setting clear technical direction, coding standards, and delivery expectations while remaining a strong individual contributor.
 



 • Own assigned software programs from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
 



 • Plan technical work, identify dependencies and risks, drive design and code reviews, and ensure timely closure of architecture, quality, security, and performance issues.
 



 • Build engineering redundancy by documenting architecture, critical workflows, deployment practices, troubleshooting playbooks, and technical decisions.
 



  





 Full Stack Architecture \& Development
 



 • Architect and develop scalable backend services primarily using Python and Golang, with well\-defined RESTful APIs and microservices boundaries.
 



 • Develop and guide React.js web applications with effective component architecture and state management using modern React patterns such as Hooks and Redux where appropriate.
 



 • Design robust data models, database schemas, indexes, and queries in PostgreSQL; diagnose and resolve database performance, concurrency, and data\-integrity issues.
 



 • Apply secure authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth / JWT, role\-based access control, secrets management, and service\-to\-service security.
 



 Connected Devices, Real\-Time Data \& IoT Integration
 



 • Design application flows for connected field devices, edge gateways, and cloud services, including device discovery, provisioning, configuration, heartbeat / health monitoring, telemetry, command\-and\-control, and event handling.
 



 • Implement and support real\-time and event\-driven communication using MQTT, REST APIs, Kafka, WebSockets and, where applicable, SIP / WebRTC or related communication technologies.
 



 • Engineer reliable message handling for intermittent networks and field conditions, including reconnect behaviour, retries, idempotency, duplicate handling, buffering, and fault recovery.
 



 • Collaborate with embedded, hardware, test, and product teams to integrate device protocols, APIs, telemetry streams, and alarms into unified web and cloud applications.
 



 Cloud, Containers \& Data Platforms
 



 • Design and deploy applications on AWS using services such as EC2, S3, RDS and other appropriate managed services, with attention to scalability, availability, security, and cost.
 



 • Containerize services using Docker and contribute to cloud\-native deployment patterns, release automation, and environment management.
 



 • Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated build/test/deploy practices, configuration management, and controlled production releases.
 



 • Design and operate streaming and asynchronous pipelines using Apache Kafka and related messaging technologies; exposure to Hadoop / large\-scale data processing is advantageous.
 



 Reliability, Security, Quality \& Production Support

 12Mandatory (Working style): Must be comfortable working from an outcome and constraints instead of a fully specified ticket, and improving a live store already taking orders, not only greenfield builds.

 14Mandatory (Note): Will be responsible for building and owning both the current domestic storefront and the upcoming international storefront.

 16Preferred (Tech): Headless / Hydrogen experience; Shopify Plus / Shopify Markets / checkout extensibility; JSON\-LD and technical SEO / AEO for e\-commerce; and the ability to implement a Figma file faithfully while flagging what won't work on mobile.

title: Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:** 
 390443
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**NTT DATA Job Description**
**IDP Platform Engineer**
**Practice**
 Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platform team
   

  

**Location**
 India, offshore delivery centre
   

  

**Start dates**
 November 2026 (x2\); January 2027 (x3\)
   

  

**Positions**
 Grade 10\-11
   

  

**Reports to**
 IDP Technical PM
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Integration development: Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* Catalogue data: Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* Workflow orchestration: Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* Pipeline products: Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* Developer enablement: Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* Integration runtime: Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* Performance testing capability: Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* Quality gates: Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.


**Essential**
* CI/CD depth: 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* Kubernetes: Solid working Kubernetes
* Scripting and APIs: Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* Software engineering: Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* API integration: Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* Enablement mindset: A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* Pipeline security: Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* Test automation in CI: integrate automated testing into pipelines


**Nice to Have**
* Durable orchestration: Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* IaC: Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* Performance testing: k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* Ecosystem: Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* Security: Container and Kubernetes security.


**Technologies \& Tools**
 The platform environment:
   

  

* Developer portal: Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* Languages: TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* Delivery toolchain: GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* Integrations: ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

 Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
   

  

***NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.***

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.  Tools \& Methodologies

 Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies.
   

  

 Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue\-Green, and Rolling deployments.
   

  

 Infrastructure \& Cloud

 Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
   

  

 Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments.
   

  

 Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Java|React) (f/m/d)
description:
What do we do?
   

  

 Thinkproject is the leading platform for construction and infrastructure information management — used by engineering, construction and operations teams across Europe, the Middle East, and APAC to manage complex built assets across their entire lifecycle.
   

  

 Our platform connects 9 products into a unified data ecosystem: document control, BIM coordination, field execution, asset management, and AI\-powered project intelligence. Our customers include major infrastructure owners, contractors and engineering firms managing some of the most technically demanding projects in the world.
   

  

 The analytics applications you will build are how our customers and internal teams understand, interact with, and act on the data our platform collects. They are the user\-facing layer of the data ecosystem.
   

  

 What your day will look like
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Senior Full Stack Engineer (f/m/d)** 
 to build and evolve the analytics and data applications that serve our customers and internal teams — and to lead the modernisation of the legacy Java/Spring Batch ingestion layer that currently underpins them.
   

  

 This is a highly hands\-on role with breadth across backend (Java/Spring, Python), frontend
   

  

 (TypeScript/React), cloud (GCP, Cloud Run, GKE), and data. You will own features end\-to\-end: from design through implementation, deployment, and production operation.
   

  

 The Spring Batch modernisation is the most technically substantive challenge in this role. You will be inheriting legacy ingestion services that need to be redesigned, migrated to cloud\-native GCP architecture, and retired cleanly — without disrupting the analytics applications that depend on them.
   

  

 That's the real work
   

  

**Time allocation (approximate):**
 \~40% analytics application development (frontend \+ backend) \| \~30% Spring Batch modernisation and cloud\-native migration \| \~15% platform reliability and operations \| \~15% architecture, documentation, and mentoring
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Analytics \& Data Applications**
* Design, build, and operate enterprise analytics portals that integrate with modern visualization and reporting platforms
* Build self\-service data access applications for internal and external customers
* Develop administration portals for data onboarding, configuration management, and platform administration
* Implement secure, scalable, and maintainable application components for a global customer base
* Build and maintain APIs consumed by analytics applications, administration tools, and third\-party integrations


**Platform Modernisation**
* Maintain, enhance, and progressively retire legacy Spring Batch and Java\-based ingestion solutions
* Design and implement modern cloud\-native replacements using GCP services (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GKE) where appropriate
* Reduce technical debt systematically — not just keep it at bay
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency as part of modernisation work
* Contribute to architecture decisions on the migration target state


**Full Stack Engineering**
* Develop modern web applications using TypeScript and React — from component design to production deployment
* Build backend services, REST APIs, and integrations in Java (Spring Boot/Spring Batch) and Python
* Implement event\-driven integrations where the architecture requires it
* Build reusable libraries, components, and tooling that improve productivity across the team


**Software Engineering Excellence**
* Apply test\-driven development, code reviews, CI/CD, and automated testing as default practice
* Produce high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-documented software
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to component\-level design decisions
* Continuously improve engineering standards and code quality across the team


**AI\-Assisted Engineering**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent agentic coding platforms) to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation
* Maintain full engineering accountability for delivered software — AI tooling accelerates your work; it doesn't replace your judgment


 What you need to fulfill the role
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* You are a strong full stack engineer with Java/Spring depth on the backend and TypeScript/React on the frontend — and you have worked in cloud\-native environments on GCP. Specifically:
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong Java proficiency — Spring Boot and Spring Batch in production; you can read, debug, and extend Spring Batch jobs under real production pressure
* Strong Python proficiency — backend services, data pipelines, scripting
* Strong TypeScript and React proficiency — building production\-grade web applications, not component libraries in isolation
* Strong REST API design and implementation experience
* Strong GCP experience — Cloud Run and GKE in particular; you have deployed and operated services on these platforms
* Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, microservices architecture, and API design principles
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices TDD, automated unit and integration tests, and code review as standard practice
* Experience troubleshooting production systems and leading root cause analysis


**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Skills)**
* Event\-driven architecture experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Cloud Storage triggers)
* Redux or modern state management framework experience
* GraphQL experience
* Next.js experience
* Data warehousing concepts and data modelling (BigQuery, Snowflake)
* Experience building internal enterprise platforms or administration portals
* Experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring junior engineers
* Experience working in globally distributed engineering organisations


**Soft Skills**
* Ownership mindset — you drive work to completion without being managed
* Comfortable with technical ambiguity — the Spring Batch modernisation does not have a finished design; you will help define it
* Strong communicator across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Mentors naturally — you invest in the growth of engineers around you
* Balances delivery speed with software quality — you know when to move fast and when to slow down


**What Success Looks Like**
**In 30 days**

 5\+ years

 We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in Python and React to build and evolve reliable, secure, and scalable applications end\-to\-end.

You should be comfortable incorporating AI coding assistants and agentic development tools into your daily workflow while recognizing when complex, security\-sensitive, or business\-critical logic requires careful human design, implementation, and validation.

* 5–8 years of professional full\-stack software development experience, with strong hands\-on depth across both frontend and backend engineering.

* Experience working with sensitive, regulated, or confidential data, ideally in environments involving HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or similar compliance standards.
* A strong engineering mindset around security, auditability, access controls, data privacy, data integrity, and deterministic system behavior.
* Ability to work effectively as a senior individual contributor, providing technical leadership through execution and judgment without needing to be the most senior person in the room.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance engineering quality, product requirements, delivery timelines, and long\-term maintainability.
* Past work experience in over\-lapping shifts.



  





**Nice to Have\-** 



* Experience in healthcare technology or fintech.

* Familiarity with designing systems for highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments.
* Experience establishing or improving engineering practices around AI\-assisted development, code review, testing, and developer productivity.

title: Tech Lead – Production Support & Application Development
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 Technical Lead – Production Support \& Application Development
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on technical professional with 5\+ years of experience in production support and application development for enterprise applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, contribute to application enhancements, and work closely with development, QA, support, product, and business teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud platforms.
* Perform root cause analysis and contribute to permanent fixes to reduce recurring incidents.
* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain enterprise application features, services, and integrations.
* Analyze logs, monitoring alerts, database issues, and system behavior to identify and resolve defects.
* Support deployment, release validation, post\-release checks, and operational stability activities.
* Collaborate with development, QA, support, product, and business teams to ensure timely issue resolution and smooth delivery.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, production support, application support, or production engineering.
* Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and backend application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, query troubleshooting, and data validation.
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
* Experience troubleshooting application, API, database, integration, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, Agile/DevOps practices, and release support.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and basic understanding of containers or cloud\-hosted applications.


 Good\-to\-have Skills
   

  

* Experience with Salesforce integrations, CRM platforms, licensing, entitlement, order management, subscription, or customer\-facing business applications.
* Knowledge of GraphQL, microservices, messaging platforms, API management, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Application Insights, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar platforms.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should be a practical, hands\-on engineer with strong debugging skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to balance production stability with development delivery. They should communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and be willing to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.
   

  

 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

title: IT Application Services Specialist
description:
**About Toll Group**
 At Toll, we do more than just logistics \- we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Execute tasks leveraging domain expertise in ServiceNow development, with a focus on ITSM and ITOM modules.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of organizational processes and platform capabilities.
* Analyze and resolve a range of moderately complex issues using established policies, ITIL best practices, and platform governance standards.
* Operate with moderate supervision, following structured procedures and development guidelines.
* Perform a variety of routine and semi\-complex assignments across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, SAM, HAM, HRSD, GBS and Employee Center.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of new team members.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**What You’ll Need**
* 7\-12 years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development and platform configuration.
* Proven experience in implementing and supporting ServiceNow ITSM and ITOM modules, including Discovery, CMDB, Event Management, and Service Mapping.
* Proficiency in designing and maintaining integrations using REST, SOAP, and other web technologies (HTTP, AJAX, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C\+\+).
* Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Node.js, jQuery, Apache Jelly, or React.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Experience in developing and deploying ServiceNow applications and modules including Employee Center, SAM, HAM, HRSD, and ITSM.
* Create and implement Business rules, UI Actions, UI Policies, and Client Scripts for various applications in ServiceNow.
* Develop strategies for identifying issues and gaps for various modules in ITSM and ITOM areas.
* Experienced in various phases of Event Management which includes configuring Event Mapping Rules, Event Transform Rules, and Alert Rules.
* Experienced in customizing Email Notifications, Inbound Email Actions, Reports, and Dashboards.
* Implemented integrations between ServiceNow and third\-party applications using REST and SOAP APIs. Experienced in creating homepages and dashboards for stakeholders.
* Ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code; debug and optimize for performance and scalability.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Working knowledge of ITIL framework and its application within ServiceNow.


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* ServiceNow Certifications (at least two of the following preferred):
+ Certified System Administrator
+ Certified Application Developer
+ Certified Implementation Specialist (SAM, HAM, HRSD, or ITSM)

* Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday, SAP, or Microsoft Entra.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management principles.


**Why Join Us?**
 At Toll Group, we are committed to transforming enterprise operations through technology. You’ll be part of a team driving automation, improving onboarding processes, and enhancing regulatory compliance through ServiceNow. This is a unique opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive environment while contributing to impactful projects.
   

  

**What moves you?**
 At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000\+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry\-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.
   

  

 Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
   

  

 At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.
   

  

 To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com
   

  

 You must be entitled to work in India and be prepared to undertake pre\-employment checks including a criminal history check and medical.
