title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a software engineering manager to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI\-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll lead a full\-stack team of engineers and collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver client\-facing features that will set us apart from our competitors.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage a small team of frontend and backend engineers that will grow as you do
* Own technical design and implementation for some of your projects to set a good example for the ICs
* Work with platform teams to deliver features with consistent capabilities
* Drive the career growth of your direct reports
* Stay up to date on industry trends, such as AI tooling, that can make the team more effective
* Collaborate with ADM engineering and product leads in the US, UK and India to drive team\-wide process improvements and best practices


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Minimum 10\+ years of software engineering experience
* Minimum 2\+ years managing software engineering teams
* Full\-stack, product engineering experience a big plus
* React experience a plus
* Strong experience with Python OR Java will be required
* Experience with AWS will be highly preferred


***Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (hybrid work model)***
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Workday Technical Consultant
description:
* 2\+ years of experience in leading the design, development and implementation of Workday HCM(Technical/Functional)
* Design and develop Workday Integrations and reporting solutions to meet business requirements
* Configure and maintain Workday Integrations, EIB, CC, Workday Studio, dashboards, and BIRT reports
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and deliver actionable insights
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Workday Integrations and Workday Studio functionality
* Good experience in Workday integration, Workday report development, testing and validation
* Leads and manages the Technical Solution process/ design, release management
* Strong hands\-on experience in Workday technologies \- Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Advanced Report Writer, Cloud Connect (PICOF, PECI, CCW, CCB), Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, Custom fields, XML/XSLT, Studio, BIRT Reporting \& data analytics


 A day in the life of an Infoscion
   

  

* As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment
* You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs
* You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to\-be\-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.
* You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root\-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives
* You will also contribute to unit\-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
* Ability to develop value\-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
* Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
* Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
* Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
* Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
* Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
* One or two industry domain knowledge
* Client Interfacing skills
* Project and Team management

title: Team Lead – Software Development
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
 Rockwell Automation's Safety, Sensing \& Industrial Components Business is looking for an experienced Software Team Lead. This lead will lead a product team of engineers on all stages of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, and testing activities for industry\-leading software. title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.


**Reports To:** 
 Manager, Customer Success Operations
   

  

**Global Technical Alignment:** 
 Director of Technical Delivery
   

  

**Regional Scope:** 
 APAC

* Develop responsive front\-end components using React.js, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap.

* Develop unit tests, integration tests, mock services, and participate in code reviews and static code analysis.

* Support production integrations, customer onboarding, and complex implementation activities.

 React.js, Redux, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap
* **API \& Services:** 
 REST, SOAP, JSON, API\-first, synchronous/asynchronous integrations
* **Security:** 
 OAuth/OAuth2, token\-based authentication, API security, certificates, encryption
* **Database:** 
 PostgreSQL
* **Cloud Platform:** 
 GCP
* Experience integrating Payment Service Providers (PSPs), payment gateways, and payment orchestration platforms.
* Knowledge of Cards, Digital Wallets, Alternative Payment Methods (APMs), callbacks, webhooks, redirects, and payment status flows.
* Knowledge of PCI DSS, payment security, tokenization, encryption, certificates, and compliance.
* Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, and integration lifecycle management.

* Experience building highly available, resilient, high\-volume, and transaction\-intensive integration platforms.

* We offer you the opportunity to be an innovator, challenge the status quo, and redefine the payments category

🚀
 **Full Stack Developer – MERN Stack Build Something Extraordinary with AI Unika** 




  





**AI Unika Technologies Pvt. Ltd.** 




**\| 3\+ Years Experience \|** 




 \|
 **CTC Up to ₹7 LPA \|** 





 \|
 **Hinjewadi, Pune \|** 




**\| Full\-Time \|** 




**\| Work From Office** 
 \|
 



  





 About AI Unika
 



 AI Unika is a technology company building intelligent products for real\-world problems across
 **Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Automation, Mobility, Data and Software Engineering** 
 . We are not interested in simply creating another software product or building a company where people come to work, complete assigned tickets and go home. We are building a team that wants to create something meaningful, ambitious and lasting.
 



 We are at a stage where the right people can genuinely influence what the company becomes. Your work can be seen, your ideas can be heard and your decisions can directly contribute to the products we build. That's why this opportunity is for someone who is looking for more than a designation and a monthly salary.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Full Stack Developer with 3\+ years of strong hands\-on MERN Stack experience** 
 who genuinely enjoys building products. Someone who can take an idea or business problem, understand what needs to be solved, design the right technical approach, build the application, deploy it, troubleshoot it in production and continuously make it better.
 



 You will work primarily with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript** 
 , building complete applications rather than working within a narrow technical boundary. You should be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, database, APIs and production environments whenever the product requires it.
 



 Your work will involve developing modern React applications, designing reusable components, building Node.js and Express.js backend services, creating secure REST APIs, designing MongoDB schemas and aggregation pipelines, integrating third\-party services, implementing authentication and authorization, optimizing application performance and supporting production deployments.
 



  





 💻 Technical Skills \& Qualifications
 


* **3\+ years** 
 of professional Full Stack Development experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js**
* Excellent knowledge of
 **JavaScript (ES6\+)**
* Good hands\-on experience with
 **React.js** 
 , Hooks, component architecture and state management
* Strong experience developing
 **Node.js \+ Express.js** 
 backend applications
* Strong understanding of
 **RESTful API design, development and integration**
* Strong knowledge of
 **MongoDB schema design, aggregation, indexing and query optimization**
* Experience with
 **authentication, authorization and API security**
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming and event\-driven architecture
* Experience with
 **Git/GitHub/GitLab** 
 and collaborative development workflows
* Strong understanding of
 **HTML5, CSS3 and responsive web development**
* Knowledge of clean code, reusable architecture and software development best practices
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Understanding of application performance, scalability and security
* Experience with production application deployment and maintenance
* Working knowledge of
 **AWS or equivalent cloud platforms**
* Experience with
 **Docker and CI/CD** 
 is an advantage
* Experience with
 **TypeScript** 
 is an advantage
* Experience integrating
 **AI APIs, LLMs, Computer Vision or automation systems** 
 is an advantage
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, testing and release management



  





 ❤️
 **We Are Looking for a Builder** 




 We can teach a framework. We can introduce you to a new technology. We can help you understand a new business domain.
 



 What is much harder to teach is
 **the desire to build something extraordinary.** 




 We want someone who sees an unfinished product and gets excited rather than uncomfortable. Someone who can receive a difficult requirement and say,
 **“Let's figure it out.”** 
 Someone who doesn't need every step explained before beginning. Someone who takes ownership when something breaks, thinks about why a feature exists instead of blindly implementing it, and cares about whether the customer actually benefits from what was built.
 



 At AI Unika, we don't want developers who only ask,
 **“What should I code?”** 




 We want developers who ask,
 **“What are we trying to achieve, and what is the best way to build it?”** 




  





 🚀
 **Our Startup Culture** 




 AI Unika is a startup, and startup life is different. Not every requirement will arrive perfectly documented. Priorities can change. New problems can appear unexpectedly. Sometimes the most important work of the day won't be mentioned in your original job description.
 



 Our culture is simple:
 



**“Every work is my work. We complete every challenge as one team.”** 




 If the product needs help, we help. If production has a problem, we solve it. If another team needs technical support, we contribute. If the customer has a problem, we don't start by asking whose responsibility it is—we start by asking how we can solve it.
 



 Your designation tells us your expertise.
 **It does not define the limit of your contribution.** 




 We value people who step forward, learn quickly, communicate openly and take responsibility even when nobody is standing behind them.
 



  





 🤝
 **Work Close to the Action** 




 You will have the opportunity to work closely with
 **Founders, Product, Technology, Business and other teams** 
 , giving you exposure that goes far beyond writing code.
 



 You'll understand why a product is being built, what customers actually need, how business decisions influence technology and how technology ultimately creates value. If you have a better technical idea, we expect you to bring it forward. If you see a risk, we expect you to raise it. If you believe something can be built better, we want you to challenge it constructively.
 



 We want engineers who can
 **think like owners** 
 , not simply execute instructions.
 



  





 🌍
 **Build Technology That Goes Into the Real World** 




 Your work at AI Unika may contribute to products involving
 **AI, Computer Vision, Mobility, Automation, Data, SaaS and intelligent systems** 
 . You may work with real\-world datasets, intelligent workflows, third\-party platforms, APIs and applications that are used outside the development environment.
 



 You will experience the complete journey of software:
 



**Build it. Deploy it. Watch it work. Find what doesn't work. Fix it. Improve it. Scale it.** 




 That experience is difficult to gain when your entire career is limited to maintaining an already\-finished product.
 



  





 📈
 **What This Opportunity Can Become** 




 We don't want your next five years to simply add five years to your resume.
 



 We want those years to fundamentally change what you're capable of.
 



 Your growth at AI Unika will come from the problems you can solve, the products you can own, the responsibility you can handle and the impact you create. As your capability grows, your responsibility can grow with it.
 



 You may begin by owning features, then larger modules, architecture, technical decisions and eventually complete products or teams. The opportunity will be driven by
 **capability, ownership, performance, learning and contribution** 
 .
 



  





 💰
 **Compensation** 




 The CTC for this position is
 **up to ₹7 LPA** 
 , with the final compensation determined based on experience, technical capability, practical problem\-solving ability, interview performance and overall suitability.
 



 We understand that salary is important. Everyone deserves fair compensation for their work.
 



 But there is something we want to be very clear about.
 



**If you're looking for this role only because you want a salary hike or a bigger number on your CTC, this may not be the right opportunity for you.** 




 We respect people who priorities compensation, but that's not the person we're trying to build our core team around.
 



 At AI Unika,
 **we are looking for assets, not liabilities.** 




 We want people who make the organization stronger because they are here. People who create value instead of simply consuming resources. People who take responsibility, learn continuously, solve problems and help the entire team move forward.
 



 If your mindset is only
 **“What will I get?”** 
 , we may not be the right fit.
 



 If your mindset is
 **“What can I build, what can I learn, what can I contribute and what can I become?”** 
 , then we genuinely want to meet you.
 



  





 🌟 Maybe This Is the Opportunity You've Been Waiting For
 



 There are thousands of Full Stack Developer openings.
 



 Most will offer you a technology stack, a designation, a salary and a defined list of responsibilities.
 



 We are offering something different.
 



 You can join while the journey is still being written. You can work on products that are still evolving. You can sit close to the people making decisions. You can see your code become a real feature, your feature become a real product and your product create real impact.
 



 You won't simply inherit someone else's roadmap.
 



**You can help shape it.** 




 You won't simply maintain someone else's creation.
 



**You can help create something of your own.** 




 And perhaps years from now, the most valuable thing you remember won't be the salary you received in your first year.
 



 It will be the things you learned, the problems you solved, the people you built with and the products you can point to and say:
 



**“I was there when we built this.”** 




 If that feeling matters to you more than simply finding another job,
 **AI Unika could be the place you've been looking for.** 




 🚀 AI Unika
 **Build something real. Own your work. Learn without limits. Grow with the journey. Create something you'll be proud of. we People First Company.** 




  





 If You are looking something similar and Having experience of 5 Years
 



  





**Drop Your CV\- hr@aiunika.com**

We care about clean engineering and real business impact for the brands we work with.
 


**About the Role** 

 We're looking for a Shopify Full Stack Developer who enjoys building seamless, high\-performing, and visually polished e\-commerce experiences. You'll work across Shopify's front\-end and back\-end layers — building custom themes, extending Shopify's capabilities using Liquid and TypeScript, and integrating APIs to deliver scalable, optimized storefronts. If you like turning design mock\-ups into pixel\-perfect, fast\-loading storefronts and solving real e\-commerce problems with clean, maintainable code, this role is for you.
 


**What You'll Actually Be Doing** 

 A typical month might include:
 



 ●     Building or customizing a Shopify theme from scratch based on a Figma design, making sure it's pixel\-perfect and fast\-loading across devices
 



 ●     Extending a client's storefront using Liquid and TypeScript to add a custom feature — say, a subscription flow or a product bundling widget

 ●     Setting up or troubleshooting webhooks and OAuth\-based API authentication for a custom app
 



 ●     Debugging a tricky cross\-browser or performance issue flagged during QA, and tracing it back to root cause
 



 ●     Reviewing Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse scores for a storefront and making targeted optimizations
 



 ●     Pairing with a UI/UX designer to make sure an implementation matches the intended design down to the details
 



 ●     Managing a theme or app deployment, and keeping the CI/CD and version\-control workflow clean
 



 ●     Exploring headless/Hydrogen\-based setups for a client interested in a more custom front\-end architecture
 


**What We're Looking For** 

 ●     Strong proficiency in Shopify Liquid, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap
 



 ●     Experience building and customizing Shopify themes from scratch
 



 ●     Solid understanding of responsive design, cross\-browser compatibility, and performance optimization
 



 ●     Strong understanding of Shopify's data models (Products, Collections, Customers, Orders, etc.)

 ●     Working knowledge of webhooks, OAuth authentication, and Shopify Plus workflows
 



 ●     Comfort designing integrations with third\-party tools (ERP, CRM, analytics, marketing systems)
 



 ●     Understanding of REST and GraphQL APIs, rate limits, and caching techniques
 



 ●     Strong grasp of Git/GitHub and collaborative version control
 



 ●     Experience with manual and automated testing for e\-commerce functionality
 



 ●     Understanding of SEO best practices, structured data, and page performance metrics
 



 ●     Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working in Agile/Scrum teams
 



 ●     We don't care about degrees or pedigree — we care about what you can build and how you think
 


**Nice to Have (not required)** 

 ●     Experience with JavaScript frameworks like React, especially for headless or Hydrogen\-based setups
 



 ●     Exposure to Shopify CLI and build tools like Webpack or Vite
 



 ●     Familiarity with CDN optimization, error tracking, and web performance monitoring tools
 



 ●     Prior experience working on global/international Shopify stores
 


**What We Offer** 

 ●     Opportunity to work on global Shopify stores and headless commerce architectures
 



 ●     A collaborative, engineering\-first culture that values innovation and code quality
 



 ●     Exposure to cutting\-edge Shopify tech (Hydrogen, Oxygen, Remix)
 



 ●     Flexible working environment and work\-life balance

 You will build an enterprise internal developer platform on Port.io as part of a single full\-stack engineering pool. title: Senior Software Engineer - Full stack
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

**We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer \- Full stack**
**You’ll Make a Difference By**
* We are looking for an experienced and analytically sharp Senior Full\-Stack Engineer to join our team, working at the intersection of high\-fidelity simulation, modern web technologies, and reliable software delivery. This is a technically demanding role suited for someone who takes pride in end\-to\-end ownership, thinks rigorously about correctness, and understands that in our domain, simulation results are not advisory, they are binding.
* Our mission is to deliver robust, web\-based simulation software to both internal teams and external customers, enabling complex decision\-making grounded in accurate, trustworthy computational results. Errors are not just inconvenient; they carry real commercial consequences. This demands an engineering culture where precision and reliability are treated as first\-class requirements, not afterthoughts.
* Key Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and maintain a full\-stack web\-based simulation application from backend computation to user\-facing interfaces
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of features, from architecture and implementation through to deployment and monitoring in cloud environments
* Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of simulation outputs, applying rigorous testing and validation practices commensurate with the commercial stakes involved
* Collaborate across disciplines, working closely with domain experts, simulation specialists, and product stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust software solutions
* Champion engineering best practices across the codebase, including code quality, observability, and deployment hygiene
* Required Skills
* Strong proficiency in Rust and Python for backend and simulation logic
* Experience with physics simulation, numerical methods, or scientific computing
* Solid experience with Angular for building responsive, production\-grade web frontends
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized, scalable deployments
* Practical knowledge of AWS cloud services as well as on\-prem deployments, and cloud\-native architecture patterns
* 
* Experience designing and implementing audit logging, including immutable audit trails
* Solid understanding of relational databases
* A genuine end\-to\-end mindset, comfortable owning a feature across the full stack and across the full delivery lifecycle
* Strong analytical thinking and a structured approach to problem\-solving, with a natural instinct for questioning assumptions and validating outputs
* A strong team player with excellent collaboration skills, able to work effectively across interdisciplinary and intercultural teams
* Nice to Have
* Familiarity with simulation validation frameworks or uncertainty quantification
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (e.g., Terraform, Helm)


**Your Success Is Grounded In**
* 5\-8 years of experience is required.
* Great Communication skills.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills


**Join us and be yourself!**
 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Pune** 
 , where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

**www.siemens.com/careers**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise** 
 to join our engineering team building and scaling a
 **PCI DSS v4\.0–ready, microservices\-based order processing platform** 
 . This platform running on a secure, private\-network Azure architecture.
 



 You will work across the full stack — from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD — building secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment\-adjacent environment.
 



**What You'll Work On** 



* Design, build, and maintain
 **Python\-based microservices on Azure Functions** 
 (Python 3\.11/3\.12\) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
* Build and secure APIs exposed through
 **Azure API Management (APIM)** 
 — including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand\-scoped RBAC, and correlation\-ID based tracing.
* Work within a
 **Private VNet architecture** 
 , integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway–based outbound connectivity to third\-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
* Design and maintain schemas in a
 **shared Azure SQL Database** 
 using module\-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
* Implement
 **secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault** 
 using Managed Identity — ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
* Build
 **tokenized payment integrations** 
 (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage — token\-only handling.
* Contribute to
 **PCI DSS v4\.0 compliance controls** 
 : network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
* Support
 **queue\- and timer\-triggered async processing** 
 (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
* Collaborate on
 **cost\-optimization decisions** 
 — right\-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using
 **Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 
 .
* Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well\-tested code.



  





 Requirements
 



**What We're Looking For** 




**Required:** 



* 6–9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full\-stack capability.
* Deep hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 (3\.x) for backend/microservice development.
* Solid experience building and deploying on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 , specifically:
* Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
* Azure API Management
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Key Vault \& Managed Identity
* Azure VNet, NSGs, Private Endpoints, NAT Gateway
* Experience designing
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices architectures.
* Experience with
 **relational database design** 
 (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption\-at\-rest concepts).
* Understanding of
 **secure application design** 
 : secrets management, least\-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
* Familiarity with
 **asynchronous/queue\-based or timer\-based processing patterns** 
 .
* Experience integrating with
 **third\-party APIs** 
 (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
* Working knowledge of
 **monitoring/observability tools** 
 (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and cloud deployment practices.



**Preferred / Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working in a
 **PCI DSS–regulated environment** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **e\-commerce order management systems** 
 (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
* Experience with
 **tokenized payment processing** 
 (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
* Familiarity with
 **Infrastructure as Code** 
 (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
* Front\-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full\-stack contributions beyond APIs.
* Experience with
 **cost optimization** 
 on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right\-sizing).
* Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) are a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset — comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
* Ability to work in a security\- and compliance\-conscious environment with attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment balancing scalability, security, and cost.

Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will design, build, and maintain production\-grade backend services and web applications that power personalisation and recommendation capabilities. You will work closely with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Product Owners, and Data Engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and low\-latency services.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop production\-grade APIs and service layers that expose personalisation and recommendations to consuming applications and digital experience layers.
* Build and evolve web\-based applications and user experiences.
* Build model\-serving and inference integration layers that support real\-time and batch recommendation patterns.
* Implement reliable, scalable, and low\-latency services with strong focus on resiliency, observability, and performance.
* Work with caching, event\-driven processing and distributed systems patterns to support high\-volume consumer use cases.
* Collaborate with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineering and Product teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions within the team.
* Ensure applications and services are production\-ready through effective observability, monitoring, performance optimisation, reliability engineering, and operational readiness practices.
* Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices.
* Utilise AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development and strengthen code quality.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 7\+ years of experience designing and building scalable, resilient, and maintainable microservices and web applications in modern cloud environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building production backend services.
* Frontend development experience with React framework strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of system design and distributed architecture.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals including concurrency, asynchronous processing, idempotency, exception handling and circuit breakers.
* Strong data structures and algorithms foundation with experience applying them to real\-world use cases.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Experience with SQL/No\-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications will be a strong advantage.
* Understanding of embedding\-based similarity search and vector databases is an advantage.
* Strong ability to mentor engineers, review designs, and drive sound technical decisions.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is preferred.

 The Full Stack Engineer will design reliable, scalable platforms to build our important systems and services throughout the company. As an experienced and passionate member of an agile capability team you will deploy leading edge engineering and product configuration solutions that deliver value to our customers. The team uses .NET, C\#, JavaScript, SQL, HTML/CSS, RESTful web services and Azure cloud technology to deliver these new innovative solutions.

title: Development Team Lead (.NET)
description:
**Role Description** 




 This role has been created to:
 


* Serve to support the role requirements of senior developers in the Analyst Developer job family.

* Support delivery obligations to customers and internal stakeholders.



  





**Specific Role Responsibilities** 




  





**Analysis and Design** 



* Work with the Testing team in the creation of user story definitions and acceptance criteria. Utilize your knowledge to ensure stories are constructed in a cohesive, logical way that aids smooth implementation and test.
* Work within the constraints of the feature/user story to define the underlying design required to deliver these changes

* Provide solutions and recommendations for the resolution of technical issues that arise and ensure solutions meet the technical specs and design requirements

**Development** 



* Interpret complex financial business requirements and translate into high\-transactional, high\-availability, secure, working systems
* Lend your expertise to advise and influence the design and implementation of highly intuitive user interface and interactive financial tools required by financial advisers and investors
* Non\-functional requirements: Consider non\-functional requirements. We produce high\-volume, real\-time transaction processing systems that support millions of trades every day in investment securities in multiple world markets. You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant.
* Collaborate with other developers to make sure that the solutions developed are robust and in\-line with the requirements;
* Ensure code is designed and built in a reusable manner.
* Able to build high complexity features end\-to\-end
* Establish yourself as an expert in multiple system/technical areas of the FNZ platform

**Quality** 



* Adhere to the defined procedures for code management, code reviews, coding standards, naming conventions and security standards
* Write automated unit tests for any newly created code
* Perform manual testing to ensure any changes made to the system are of a high standard and the system hasn’t regressed.
* Perform code reviews for developers on their own and different projects, inside the solution center, to ensure that proposed changes meet quality and best practice standards.
* Able to design new core system functionality or completely redesign existing ones whilst maintaining quality.



  





**Collaboration and Communication** 



* Promote the development team both internally and externally. Ensure that creative solutions, tight code, tough problems solved are called out appropriately to the developer community, and where they lead to visible outcomes, to the broader FNZ teams and clients
* Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross\-project system design / solutions.
* Mentor new starters to ensure they understand both platform and SDLC.
* Provide solution center\-wide training, as required, on topics of personal expertise.
* Support the project lead developer and function as a squad lead if required.



  





**Technology** 



* Stay up to date with industry practices, new technologies, tools and methods. Proactive evaluate and provide recommendations to the business on technologies and tools which could be adopted.
* Take ownership of and resolve technical (environmental, coding and testing) issues that impede development progress. Assist in the resolution of technical issues when requested.
* Create novel solutions to problems by incorporating cutting edge technology or generic concepts.



  





**Functional Area Responsibilities** 




 Senior Analyst Developers at FNZ are all\-rounders who can work across the full stack. This role involves working with complex business requirements in a wide range of functional areas in the financial services and platform domain.
 



  





 You are in expert in multiple technical areas and make your mark as a business domain expert as well. This is evidenced in your delivery track record and your ability to execute your individual responsibilities and to provide your expertise and support to colleagues when needed.
 



 Senior Analyst Developers own non\-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well.
 



  





**Experience required** 



* Experience required 5\-9 Years.
* Expert in Microsoft .NET development products, including .NET, C\# and SQL Server.
* Expert in web development, including ASP.NET, JavaScript and ReactJS.
* Experience with the following legacy development products would be beneficial: ASP.NET MVC, VB.NET, legacy .NET Framework versions.
* Familiarity with financial products and markets.
* Understanding of web services.
* Familiar with code analysis or automated testing tools.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* First class bachelor's degree or higher and/or equivalent experience.
* Experience of working on large scale technology delivery projects and successfully delivering technology change as part of these projects.
* Confident, and able to take a lead role in a delivery\-focused environment.
* Experience of working with different levels of stakeholders within a project environment.
* Independent, self\-directing working style.
* Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast\-paced industry;.
* Enjoy working as part of a high\-performance team.
* Hard\-working, innovative and takes pride in their work.
* Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.



  





**About FNZ Culture** 




 Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork.
 



 That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.
 



 The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.
 


* Customer obsessed for the long\-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together



  





**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values** 
 : www.fnz.com/culture
 



  





**Opportunities** 



* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams \- experts in their respective fields \- who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;
* Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances;
* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;
* We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC.



  





**Commitment to Equal Opportunities** 



* At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non\-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio\-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected.
